+def test_collector_and_transport_extensions_keep_direct_storage_and_lifecycle_boundaries(package):
+    """Direct import guard; not a claim that transitive helpers are write-free."""
+    forbidden = (
+        "aletheia.storage", "aletheia.agent_runtime.scheduler",
+        "aletheia.agent_runtime.job_manager", "sqlite3", "apscheduler",
+    )
+    violations = []
+    public_collector = package in {"defillama", "coingecko", "hyperliquid", "deribit", "volume_scanner", "coinalyze", "fred", "macro"}
+    paths = list((PROJECT_ROOT / "extensions" / package).rglob("*.py"))
+    assert paths, package
+    for path in paths:
+        tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+        for node in ast.walk(tree):
+            # Coinalyze compares only same-source historical OI. This read
+            # grants no general repository access or mutation ownership.
+            if (package == "coinalyze" and isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom)
+                    and node.module == "aletheia.storage.repositories"
+                    and [alias.name for alias in node.names] == ["open_interest_near"]):
+                continue
+            if isinstance(node, ast.Import):
+                names = [alias.name for alias in node.names]
+            elif isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
+                names = [node.module or ""] + [
+                    f"{node.module}.{alias.name}" for alias in node.names
+                ]
+            else:
+                continue
+            if public_collector:
+                # DTOs are shared; only package composition binds the Core
+                # scheduler. Producer implementations own neither DB nor jobs.
+                names = [name for name in names if not (
+                    name == "aletheia.storage.models" or name.startswith("aletheia.storage.models.")
+                    or (path == PROJECT_ROOT / "extensions" / package / "__init__.py"
+                        and (name == "aletheia.agent_runtime.scheduler"
+                             or name.startswith("aletheia.agent_runtime.scheduler.")))
+                )]
+            if any(name == prefix or name.startswith(prefix + ".")
+                   for name in names for prefix in forbidden):
+                violations.append((str(path.relative_to(PROJECT_ROOT)), node.lineno))
+    assert not violations

+def test_core_consumers_do_not_import_concrete_extensions():
+    composition = {SRC / "main.py", SRC / "server" / "app.py"}
+    forbidden = ("extensions", "openai", "anthropic")
+    violations = []
+    for path in SRC.rglob("*.py"):
+        if path in composition:
+            continue
+        for module in _get_imports(path):
+            # Existing standalone process composes only its public collector.
+            if path == SRC / "data" / "collector_runner.py" and module in {

+                "extensions.deribit", "extensions.volume_scanner", "extensions.coinalyze",
+                "extensions.market_data", "extensions.fred", "extensions.macro",
+            }:
+                continue
+            if any(module == prefix or module.startswith(prefix + ".") for prefix in forbidden):
+                violations.append((str(path.relative_to(SRC)), module))
+    assert not violations

+def test_planning_and_entry_tables_have_one_storage_boundary():

+
+    allowed = {

+        SRC / "storage" / "migrations.py",

+    for sample in (

+        assert pattern.search(sample)
+    for root in (SRC, PROJECT_ROOT / "extensions", PROJECT_ROOT / "ops"):
+        for path in root.rglob("*.py"):

+            tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+            for node in ast.walk(tree):
+                if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
+                    assert not pattern.search(node.value), (path, node.lineno)

+def test_risk_decision_mutation_has_one_core_owner():
+    import re
+
+    repository = SRC / "storage" / "repositories.py"
+    engine = SRC / "risk" / "engine.py"
+    migrations = SRC / "storage" / "migrations.py"
+    writers = {"insert_risk_decision", "insert_authoritative_risk_decision"}
+    sql = re.compile(
+        r"\b(?:(?:INSERT|REPLACE)\s+(?:OR\s+\w+\s+)?INTO\s+"
+        r"|UPDATE\s+|DELETE\s+FROM\s+)risk_decisions\b",
+        re.I,
+    )
+    assert sql.search("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO risk_decisions (id) VALUES (?)")
+    assert sql.search("UPDATE RISK_DECISIONS SET approved=0")
+    assert sql.search("DELETE FROM risk_decisions WHERE id=?")
+    for root in (SRC, PROJECT_ROOT / "extensions", PROJECT_ROOT / "ops"):
+        for path in root.rglob("*.py"):
+            tree = ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
+            for node in ast.walk(tree):
+                if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == "aletheia.storage.repositories":
+                    if any(alias.name in writers for alias in node.names):
+                        assert path in {repository, engine}, (path, node.lineno)
+                if isinstance(node, ast.Constant) and isinstance(node.value, str):
+                    if path not in {repository, migrations}:
+                        assert not sql.search(node.value), (path, node.lineno)
+                if isinstance(node, ast.Call):
+                    name = (
+                        node.func.id if isinstance(node.func, ast.Name)
+                        else node.func.attr if isinstance(node.func, ast.Attribute)
+                        else None
+                    )
+                    if name in writers:
+                        assert path in {repository, engine}, (path, node.lineno, name)

+def test_order_storage_and_submission_have_one_core_boundary():

+    sql = re.compile(
+        r"\b(?:(?:INSERT|REPLACE)\s+(?:OR\s+\w+\s+)?INTO\s+"

+        re.I,
+    )
+    for sample in (

-"""CCXT-backed market-data provider — the single source of public OHLCV/tickers.
-
-Why a per-call factory (``get_market_data_provider``) instead of a cached singleton:
-ccxt.async_support binds its aiohttp session to the event loop that created it. The
-APScheduler jobs each run on a FRESH event loop (``asyncio.run`` per job), so a cached
-provider from a previous loop raises "Event loop is closed" on the next fetch. Every
-caller therefore constructs a provider, uses it, and ``await``s ``close()`` in a finally.
-
-Primary/fallback: each fetch tries the primary exchange, and on failure retries once on
-the configured fallback. Venue-pinned xStock listing checks still enter through
-``get_market_data_provider(native_ccxt=True, fallback_exchange=exchange)`` so they keep
-the managed session and malformed-market guard without substituting another venue.
-
-Documented direct-construction sites (routing through the factory would either be wrong
-or lack the CCXT-native surface they need - 2026-07-07 audit, #49):
-
-- xStocks (ON-series): builds ``CCXTProvider(exchange="bitget", fallback_exchange="bitget")``
-  because only Bitget lists those tokens and the config fallback (bybit) would not find them.
-- ``universe/registry.py::sync_registry`` and ``universe/features.py::collect_features``: use
-  ``CCXTProvider(exchange=md.ccxt_exchange, fallback_exchange=md.ccxt_fallback)`` — same
-  config resolution as the factory, but the factory returns a ``FallbackChainProvider``
-  whose surface lacks ``_ensure_primary`` + ``load_markets`` these callers need. #91 fix
-  aligned the fallback exchange resolution with the factory so the two agree.
-
-Any NEW direct construction site should be added here with its reason; a bare
-``CCXTProvider(...)`` outside this list is a review-flagged deviation.
-
-Symbols enter as canonical ``BTC/USDT`` strings or ``InstrumentId`` objects and are
-resolved to the CCXT unified symbol (with perp settle suffix when needed) at the boundary.
-OHLCV fetches are best-effort persisted to ``market_ohlcv`` so charts have history even

+def enqueue_research_run(run_id: str) -> None:
+    """Enqueue a research run for background execution."""
+    if not research_processor_available():
+        raise RuntimeError("research_processor_unavailable")
+    processor, crash_handler = _research_processor, _research_crash_handler
+
+    async def _execute():
+        try:
+            await processor(run_id)
+        except Exception as e:
+            crash_handler(run_id, e)
+
+    def _completed(future):
+        # Also covers stop before the coroutine gets its first execution step.
+        if future.cancelled():
+            crash_handler(run_id, RuntimeError("research_scheduler_stopped"))
+
+    try:
+        _ensure_research_worker_ready()
+        future = _research_worker.submit(_execute())
+        future.add_done_callback(_completed)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        crash_handler(run_id, exc)
+        raise
+

+def schedule_serenity_retry(run_id: str, run: dict, retry_count: int, next_retry_at: str) -> None:
+    """Schedule an automatic retry via APScheduler one-shot job."""
+    if not research_processor_available():
+        return
+    try:
+        from aletheia.storage import repositories as repo
+
+        scheduler = _current_scheduler()
+        if scheduler and scheduler.running:
+            run_time = datetime.fromisoformat(next_retry_at)
+
+            def _retry_job():
+                if not research_processor_available():
+                    return
+                from aletheia.storage.models import SerenityResearchRun
+                new_run = SerenityResearchRun(
+                    trigger_type=run.get("trigger_type", "manual"),
+                    mode=run.get("mode", "standard"),
+                    status="queued",
+                    parent_run_id=run_id,
+                    profile_snapshot_id=run.get("profile_snapshot_id"),
+                    brief_snapshot=run.get("brief_snapshot"),
+                    focus_theme_id=run.get("focus_theme_id"),
+                    retry_count=retry_count + 1,
+                    idempotency_key=f"serenity-retry:{run_id}:{retry_count + 1}",
+                )
+                stored, deduplicated = repo.insert_serenity_research_retry(new_run)
+                if not deduplicated:
+                    enqueue_research_run(stored["id"])
+
+            scheduler.add_job(
+                _retry_job, "date", run_date=run_time,
+                id=f"serenity_retry_{run_id}",
+                misfire_grace_time=120,
+                replace_existing=True,
+            )
+            logger.info("Scheduled auto-retry for run %s at %s", run_id, run_time.isoformat())
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.warning("Failed to schedule auto-retry for run %s: %s", run_id, e)

+"""Persisted calibration reads, scorecard semantics and optional producer binding."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+import math
+from datetime import timedelta
+
+import aletheia.analytics.execution_mode as _execution_mode
+from aletheia.analytics.outcome_integrity import (
+    is_current_outcome_artifact,
+)
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("aletheia.analytics.confidence_calibration")
+
+MIN_CALIBRATION_SAMPLE = 5
+MAX_ACTIVE_REPORT_AGE = timedelta(hours=24)
+
+_calibration_builder = None
+
+
+def configure_calibration_builder(builder) -> None:
+    global _calibration_builder
+    _calibration_builder = builder
+
+
+def get_latest_calibration_report(
+    *, execution_mode: str | None = None,
+) -> dict | None:
+    """Read most-recent calibration report for the selected execution mode.
+
+    A persisted report is only returned when its ``execution_mode`` matches
+    the resolved (or provided) selected mode (#1939).  Legacy mode-less
+    reports are ignored so a mode switch cannot reuse the previous cohort's
+    calibration under the new selected-mode identity.
+    """
+    if execution_mode is None:
+        execution_mode = _execution_mode.resolve_selected_execution_mode()
+    if not execution_mode:
+        return None
+    try:
+        from aletheia.storage.repositories import list_knowledge_items
+        items = list_knowledge_items(item_type="calibration_report", limit=5)
+        for item in items:
+            content = item.get("content")
+            if not content:
+                continue
+            try:
+                report = json.loads(content)
+            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
+                continue
+            if report.get("execution_mode") != execution_mode:
+                continue
+            # Reports written before the explicit state field cannot distinguish
+            # perfect ECE from the old no-reliable-bucket sentinel (ECE=0).
+            if (
+                report.get("ece") == 0
+                and "calibration_state" not in report
+                and "reliable_sample_count" not in report
+            ):
+                continue
+            if is_current_outcome_artifact(
+                report, max_age=MAX_ACTIVE_REPORT_AGE,
+            ):
+                return report
+        return None
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.debug("get_latest_calibration_report failed: %s", e)
+        return None
+
+
+
+
+def compute_calibration_score() -> float | None:
+    """Return 0-100 score for go-live scorecard. 100=perfect, degrades with ECE."""
+    report = get_latest_calibration_report()
+    if not report:
+        return None
+    total = report.get("total_executed", 0)
+    if total < MIN_CALIBRATION_SAMPLE:
+        return None
+    state = report.get("calibration_state")
+    if state is not None and state != "available":
+        return None
+    reliable_n = report.get("reliable_sample_count")
+    if reliable_n is not None:
+        try:
+            if int(reliable_n) <= 0:
+                return None
+        except (TypeError, ValueError):
+            return None
+    ece = report.get("ece")
+    try:
+        ece = float(ece)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    if not math.isfinite(ece):
+        return None
+    # A legacy zero without coverage metadata is ambiguous and must not grant
+    # readiness points; non-zero legacy reports remain backward-compatible.
+    if state is None and reliable_n is None and ece == 0.0:
+        return None
+    # ECE=0 → 100pts, ECE=0.20 → 60pts, ECE=0.50 → 0pts
+    score = max(0.0, 100.0 - ece * 200.0)
+    return round(min(100.0, score), 1)

+"""TradingMemo types, persisted read validation and observer rendering."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from typing import Any, NotRequired, TypedDict
+
+from aletheia.analytics.execution_mode import (
+    resolve_selected_execution_mode,
+)
+from aletheia.analytics.outcome_integrity import (
+    is_current_outcome_artifact,
+)
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("aletheia.analytics.insight_synthesizer")
+
+MAX_MEMO_AGE_HOURS = 72
+
+
+class RegimeRule(TypedDict):
+    regime: str
+    direction: str
+    edge: str  # strong / weak / contra
+    win_rate: float
+    avg_pnl_pct: float
+    sample_size: int
+
+
+class TimingRule(TypedDict):
+    dimension: str  # "hour" or "day"
+    value: str  # "08-12" or "Monday"
+    quality: str  # best / good / avoid
+    win_rate: float
+    avg_pnl_pct: float
+    sample_size: int
+
+
+class SymbolRule(TypedDict):
+    symbol: str
+    status: str  # hot / neutral / cold
+    win_rate: float
+    pnl: float
+    sample_size: int
+
+
+class AntiPattern(TypedDict):
+    pattern: str
+    loss_rate: float
+    sample_size: int
+
+
+class TradingMemo(TypedDict):
+    generated_at: str
+    valid_until: str
+    data_window_days: int
+    sample_size: int
+    regime_playbook: list[RegimeRule]
+    timing_windows: list[TimingRule]
+    symbol_affinity: list[SymbolRule]
+    anti_patterns: list[AntiPattern]
+    direction_summary: dict[str, Any]
+    key_insight: str  # one-paragraph LLM synthesis
+    prior_corrections: list[dict]  # Module J: prior judgments overturned by subsequent results
+    outcome_semantics_version: str
+    clean_window_anchor_id: str
+    clean_window_anchor_iso: str
+    source_raw_event_count: int
+    loaded_raw_event_count: int
+    cohort_complete: bool
+    ordered_source_digest: str
+    cohort_identity: dict[str, str | None]
+    execution_mode: NotRequired[str]  # absent in pre-mode-tagging memos
+
+
+def get_latest_memo(
+    *, execution_mode: str | None = None,
+) -> TradingMemo | None:
+    """Retrieve the most recent valid TradingMemo for the selected mode.
+
+    Only returns a persisted memo whose ``execution_mode`` matches the
+    resolved (or provided) selected mode (#1939).  Legacy mode-less memos
+    are ignored so a mode switch never reuses the other cohort's Learning
+    output under the new selected-mode identity.
+    """
+    if execution_mode is None:
+        execution_mode = resolve_selected_execution_mode()
+    if not execution_mode:
+        return None
+    try:
+        from aletheia.storage.repositories import list_knowledge_items
+        items = list_knowledge_items(item_type="trading_memo", limit=10)
+        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+        for item in items:
+            # Check validity via tags JSON (contains valid_until)
+            tags_raw = item.get("tags", "")
+            try:
+                tags = json.loads(tags_raw) if isinstance(tags_raw, str) else tags_raw
+            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
+                tags = {}
+            valid_until = tags.get("valid_until", "") if isinstance(tags, dict) else ""
+            if valid_until and valid_until < now:
+                continue
+            content = item.get("content", "")
+            if not content:
+                continue
+            try:
+                memo = json.loads(content)
+            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
+                continue
+            if memo.get("execution_mode") != execution_mode:
+                continue
+            if memo.get("cohort_complete") is not True or not memo.get(
+                "ordered_source_digest"
+            ):
+                continue
+            if is_current_outcome_artifact(
+                memo, max_age=timedelta(hours=MAX_MEMO_AGE_HOURS),
+            ):
+                return memo
+        return None
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.debug("get_latest_memo failed: %s", e)
+        return None
+
+
+def render_memo_for_observer(
+    memo: TradingMemo,
+    symbol: str | None = None,
+    compact: bool = False,
+) -> str:
+    """Render a concise text block for injection into market_observer/System Operator prompts.
+
+    compact=True trims to direction bias + top-2 regime edges + top-2 anti-patterns,
+    dropping timing windows, prior corrections, metadata, and key insight. Use when the
+    memo is sent per-symbol in a multi-symbol loop to reduce repeated token cost.
+    """
+    from aletheia.analytics.memo_effectiveness import memo_half_life_weight
+
+    memo_weight = memo_half_life_weight(memo.get("generated_at"))
+    lines = ["\n## Historical Performance Context (Trading Memo)"]
+    if memo.get("cohort_complete") is True and memo.get("ordered_source_digest"):
+        lines.append(
+            "Cohort: complete "
+            f"{memo.get('loaded_raw_event_count')}/{memo.get('source_raw_event_count')} "
+            f"digest={str(memo['ordered_source_digest'])[:12]}"
+        )
+
+    if not compact:
+        lines.append(f"Data: {memo['sample_size']} trades over {memo['data_window_days']} days")
+        lines.append(f"Memo time weight: {memo_weight:.2f} (half-life 7d)")
+
+    # Direction summary
+    ds = memo.get("direction_summary", {})
+    if ds.get("long") and ds.get("short"):
+        l = ds["long"]
+        s = ds["short"]
+        lines.append(f"Direction: Long {l['win_rate']}% win ({l['count']} trades, avg {l['avg_pnl_pct']}%) | "
+                     f"Short {s['win_rate']}% win ({s['count']} trades, avg {s['avg_pnl_pct']}%) → {ds.get('bias', 'balanced')}")
+
+    # Regime playbook — top 4 in full mode, top 2 in compact
+    if memo.get("regime_playbook"):
+        lines.append("Regime edges:")
+        limit = 2 if compact else 4
+        for rule in memo["regime_playbook"][:limit]:
+            weighted_win = round(float(rule["win_rate"]) * memo_weight, 1)
+            lines.append(f"  - {rule['direction']} in {rule['regime']}: "
+                         f"{rule['win_rate']}% win, time-weighted {weighted_win}%, avg {rule['avg_pnl_pct']}% "
+                         f"({rule['sample_size']} trades) → {rule['edge'].upper()}")
+
+    # Timing — omitted in compact mode
+    if not compact:
+        best_times = [t for t in memo.get("timing_windows", []) if t["quality"] == "best"]
+        avoid_times = [t for t in memo.get("timing_windows", []) if t["quality"] == "avoid"]
+        if best_times:
+            lines.append(f"Best timing: {', '.join(t['value'] for t in best_times[:2])}")
+        if avoid_times:
+            lines.append(f"Avoid timing: {', '.join(t['value'] for t in avoid_times[:2])}")
+
+    # Symbol-specific (if provided)
+    if symbol and memo.get("symbol_affinity"):
+        for sr in memo["symbol_affinity"]:
+            if sr["symbol"] == symbol:
+                lines.append(f"This symbol ({symbol}): {sr['status'].upper()} — "
+                             f"{sr['win_rate']}% win, PnL={sr['pnl']:.4f} ({sr['sample_size']} trades)")
+                break
+
+    # Anti-patterns — top 3 in full mode, top 2 in compact
+    if memo.get("anti_patterns"):
+        lines.append("Anti-patterns (avoid):")
+        limit = 2 if compact else 3
+        for ap in memo["anti_patterns"][:limit]:
+            lines.append(f"  - {ap['pattern']}: {ap['loss_rate']}% loss rate ({ap['sample_size']} trades)")
+
+    # Prior corrections — omitted in compact mode
+    if not compact and memo.get("prior_corrections"):
+        lines.append("Corrections (prior guidance overturned by later results — judgment revised):")
+        for c in memo["prior_corrections"][:3]:
+            lines.append(
+                f"  - Previously '{c.get('direction')} in {c.get('regime')}: "
+                f"{c.get('claimed_edge')}' → actual {c.get('actual_win_rate')}% win over "
+                f"{c.get('sample')} trades; {c.get('reason')}"
+            )
+
+    # Key insight (LLM summary) — omitted in compact mode
+    if not compact and memo.get("key_insight"):
+        lines.append(f"Insight: {memo['key_insight']}")
+
+    return "\n".join(lines)

+"""Pure age weighting for persisted trading-memo rendering."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from math import exp, log
+
+MEMO_HALF_LIFE_DAYS = 7.0
+
+
+def memo_half_life_weight(generated_at: str | None, *, now: datetime | None = None, half_life_days: float = MEMO_HALF_LIFE_DAYS) -> float:
+    """Return a 0..1 influence weight for a trading memo by age.
+
+    A fresh memo has weight 1.0. Every half_life_days the influence halves, so
+    stale regime guidance fades even when no explicit overturn signal exists.
+    """
+    if not generated_at:
+        return 1.0
+    try:
+        ts = datetime.fromisoformat(str(generated_at).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+    except ValueError:
+        return 1.0
+    if ts.tzinfo is None:
+        ts = ts.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+    now = now or datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+    age_days = max(0.0, (now - ts).total_seconds() / 86400.0)
+    if half_life_days <= 0:
+        return 0.0
+    return round(exp(-log(2) * age_days / half_life_days), 4)

+"""Validated persisted reasoning-feedback reads and optional producer binding."""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+from datetime import timedelta
+import aletheia.analytics.execution_mode as _execution_mode
+from aletheia.analytics.outcome_integrity import is_current_outcome_artifact
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("aletheia.analytics.reasoning_feedback")
+MAX_ACTIVE_FEEDBACK_AGE = timedelta(hours=24)
+_feedback_builder = None
+
+
+def configure_feedback_builder(builder) -> None:
+    global _feedback_builder
+    _feedback_builder = builder
+
+
+def get_latest_reasoning_feedback(
+    *, execution_mode: str | None = None,
+) -> dict | None:
+    """Read most-recent reasoning feedback for the selected execution mode.
+
+    Only returns a persisted artifact whose ``execution_mode`` matches the
+    resolved (or provided) selected mode (#1939).  Legacy mode-less artifacts
+    are ignored so a mode switch cannot silently reuse the other cohort's
+    Learning feedback.
+    """
+    if execution_mode is None:
+        execution_mode = _execution_mode.resolve_selected_execution_mode()
+    if not execution_mode:
+        return None
+    try:
+        from aletheia.storage.repositories import list_knowledge_items
+        items = list_knowledge_items(item_type="reasoning_feedback", limit=5)
+        for item in items:
+            content = item.get("content")
+            if not content:
+                continue
+            try:
+                feedback = json.loads(content)
+            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError):
+                continue
+            if feedback.get("execution_mode") != execution_mode:
+                continue
+            if feedback.get("cohort_complete") is not True or not feedback.get(
+                "ordered_source_digest"
+            ):
+                continue
+            if is_current_outcome_artifact(
+                feedback, max_age=MAX_ACTIVE_FEEDBACK_AGE,
+            ):
+                return feedback
+        return None
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.debug("get_latest_reasoning_feedback failed: %s", e)
+        return None

+"""Secrets management CLI commands (secondary surface — dashboard is primary)."""
+
+import typer
+
+from aletheia.config.secrets import set_secret, redact
+
+secrets_app = typer.Typer(no_args_is_help=True)
+
+@secrets_app.callback()
+def secrets():
+    """Explicit credential setup; inspect configured endpoints in Settings."""
+
+
+@secrets_app.command(name="set")
+def set_cmd(key: str = typer.Argument(..., help="Secret key path, e.g. bitget.demo.api_key")):
+    """Set a secret value (prompted securely, never echoed)."""
+    from aletheia.config.loader import load_config
+
+    cfg = load_config()
+    selected_live_prefix = f"{str(cfg.exchange.name or '').lower()}.live."
+    if cfg.live.state == "live_limited" and key.strip().lower().startswith(selected_live_prefix):
+        typer.echo(
+            "Error: lock live trading and re-run the selected-account preflight before rotating the selected live credentials.",
+            err=True,
+        )
+        raise typer.Exit(1)
+    value = typer.prompt(f"Value for '{key}'", hide_input=True, confirmation_prompt=True)
+    set_secret(key, value)
+    from aletheia.files.jsonl import write_audit
+    write_audit({
+        "actor": "human", "source": "cli", "event_type": "secret_rotated",
+        "entity_type": "secret", "entity_id": key,
+        "message": f"Secret '{key}' set via CLI",
+    })
+    typer.echo(f"Stored '{key}' = {redact(value)}")

+def verify_remote_control_token(provided: str) -> bool | None:
+    """Verify inside the store; None means unconfigured, False means denied."""
+    import hmac
+
+    expected = get_secret("remote_control_api_token") or get_secret("tunnel_api_token")
+    if not expected:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return hmac.compare_digest(provided, expected)
+    except TypeError:
+        # Non-ASCII headers are untrusted input, not an authentication 500.
+        return False
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def restore_secret_on_error(key: str | None):
+    """Keep one prior value inside the store for exception rollback, not crash atomicity."""
+    previous = get_secret(key) if key else None
+    try:
+        yield
+    except Exception:
+        if key:
+            if previous is None:
+                delete_secret(key)
+            else:
+                set_secret(key, previous)
+        raise
+
+
+def get_secret_status(key: str) -> dict:
+    """Project one configured reference without giving callers the raw value."""
+    value = get_secret(key)
+    return {"configured": bool(value), "last4": value[-4:] if value and len(value) >= 4 else None}
+
+
+def secret_fingerprint(value: str | None) -> str | None:
+    """One-way identity for credential verification; empty values remain absent."""
+    return hashlib.sha256(value.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest() if value else None
+
+
+def get_secret_fingerprint(key: str) -> str | None:
+    """Read one reference without returning its raw credential to the caller."""
+    return secret_fingerprint(get_secret(key))

+"""Public market-data composition and canonical timeframe/venue checks.
+
+Concrete providers are bound by existing launch entrypoints. Every factory call
+returns fresh loop-local adapters; Core never imports a concrete implementation.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Callable
+
+from aletheia.data.providers import MarketDataProvider, Ticker
+
+# Canonical timeframe → milliseconds. Single source of truth for bar durations.
+# Covers the Bitget/Binance/OKX granularities the charts UI exposes for parity
+# with mainstream exchange terminals; agent reasoning still uses the smaller
+# trading.instruments.TIMEFRAMES subset. An unlisted timeframe (e.g. "2m",
+# "1M") yields 0 from timeframe_ms(); the OHLCV route treats that as
+# unsupported when paginating.
+_TF_MS = {
+    "1m": 60_000,
+    "5m": 300_000,
+    "15m": 900_000,
+    "30m": 1_800_000,
+    "1h": 3_600_000,
+    "2h": 7_200_000,
+    "4h": 14_400_000,
+    "6h": 21_600_000,
+    "8h": 28_800_000,
+    "12h": 43_200_000,
+    "1d": 86_400_000,
+    "3d": 259_200_000,
+    "1w": 604_800_000,
+}
+
+
+def timeframe_ms(timeframe: str) -> int:
+    """Milliseconds in one bar of ``timeframe``; 0 for an unsupported timeframe."""
+    return _TF_MS.get(timeframe, 0)
+
+
+_native_provider_factory: Callable[..., MarketDataProvider] | None = None
+
+
+def configure_native_provider_factory(factory: Callable[..., MarketDataProvider] | None) -> None:
+    global _native_provider_factory
+    _native_provider_factory = factory
+
+
+def require_exact_ticker_venue(ticker: Ticker, venue: str) -> Ticker:
+    """Reject a ticker whose physical provider differs from the requested venue."""
+    if not isinstance(ticker, Ticker):
+        raise ValueError("ticker payload is not canonical")
+    expected = str(venue or "").strip().lower()
+    actual = str(ticker.provider or "").strip().lower()
+    if not expected or actual != expected:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"ticker provider {actual or 'unknown'} does not match venue "
+            f"{expected or 'unknown'}"
+        )
+    return ticker
+
+
+_spot_fallback_factory: Callable[[], list[MarketDataProvider]] | None = None
+
+
+def configure_spot_fallback_factory(factory: Callable[[], list[MarketDataProvider]] | None) -> None:
+    global _spot_fallback_factory
+    _spot_fallback_factory = factory
+
+
+def get_market_data_provider(
+    exchange: str | None = None,
+    *,
+    native_ccxt: bool = False,
+    fallback_exchange: str | None = None,
+):
+    """Construct a FRESH market-data provider (never cached).
+
+    Primary defaults to ``market_data.ccxt_exchange`` (overridable via ``exchange``).
+    Fallback defaults to ``market_data.ccxt_fallback`` and can be explicitly pinned via
+    ``fallback_exchange`` for venue-specific sources such as xStocks.
+
+    When ``enable_crypto_fallback`` is True (default), returns a FallbackChainProvider
+    wrapping CCXTProvider plus the bound public spot adapters. Callers that
+    require CCXT-native batch methods can request ``native_ccxt=True``; they still
+    enter through this factory and receive a fresh provider with configured fallback.
+    """
+    from aletheia.config.loader import load_config
+
+    md = load_config().market_data
+    primary = exchange or md.ccxt_exchange
+    ccxt = _native_provider_factory(
+        exchange=primary,
+        fallback_exchange=fallback_exchange or md.ccxt_fallback,
+    ) if _native_provider_factory is not None else None
+
+    if native_ccxt or not getattr(md, "enable_crypto_fallback", True):
+        if ccxt is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("ccxt_market_data_extension_unavailable")
+        return ccxt
+
+    from aletheia.data.sources.chain import FallbackChainProvider
+
+    fallbacks = _spot_fallback_factory() if _spot_fallback_factory is not None else []
+    if ccxt is None and not fallbacks:
+        raise RuntimeError("ccxt_market_data_extension_unavailable")
+    return FallbackChainProvider(([ccxt] if ccxt is not None else []) + fallbacks)

+"""Derivatives collector — funding rate and open interest.
+
+Liquidations are now collected by CoinalyzeCollector
+(extensions/coinalyze/collector.py). The previous CCXT-based liquidation
+path was removed because:
+  - Most exchanges don't implement CCXT fetchLiquidations.
+  - Binance forceOrders REST requires API key authentication since 2025.
+  - The collected data had no downstream consumer (confirmed by inline comment).
+See GAP-DU-C02 / data_utilization.md §4 for the full rationale.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import logging
+from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
+from typing import Any
+
+from aletheia.data.models import (
+    FundingRateSnapshot,
+    OpenInterestSnapshot,
+)
+from aletheia.data import derivatives_facts
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("aletheia.data.collectors.derivatives")
+
+_positioning_reader = None
+
+
+def configure_positioning_reader(reader) -> None:
+    global _positioning_reader
+    _positioning_reader = reader
+
+
+async def collect_positioning(symbols: list[str], family: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    if _positioning_reader is None:
+        return {}
+    return await _positioning_reader(symbols, family)
+
+class DerivativesCollector:
+    domain = "derivatives"
+
+    async def collect(self, symbols: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        from aletheia.data.ccxt_provider import get_market_data_provider
+        from aletheia.config.loader import load_config
+
+        provider = get_market_data_provider(native_ccxt=True)
+        funding: list[FundingRateSnapshot] = []
+        oi: list[OpenInterestSnapshot] = []
+        errors: list[str] = []
+
+        cfg = load_config()
+        # LSR is a single-exchange (Binance) signal regardless of primary. Pull once
+        # for all symbols up-front so a failure here cannot mask the OI write — per
+        # spec MS-C01: LSR failure must NOT prevent OpenInterestSnapshot persistence.
+        lsr_map: dict[str, dict] = {}
+        top_position_map: dict[str, dict] = {}
+        try:
+            if cfg.market_data.enable_long_short_ratio:
+                positioning_results = await asyncio.gather(
+                    collect_positioning(symbols, "global_account_ratio"),
+                    collect_positioning(symbols, "top_position_ratio"),
+                    return_exceptions=True,
+                )
+                for label, result in zip(
+                    ("global_account_ratio", "top_position_ratio"),
+                    positioning_results,
+                    strict=True,
+                ):
+                    if isinstance(result, BaseException):
+                        errors.append(f"{label}_batch:{type(result).__name__}")
+                    elif label == "global_account_ratio":
+                        lsr_map = result
+                    else:
+                        top_position_map = result
+                    if not isinstance(result, BaseException):
+                        for sym in dict.fromkeys(symbols):
+                            if sym not in result:
+                                errors.append(f"{label}_missing {sym}")
+        except Exception as e:
+            errors.append(f"lsr_batch: {e}")
+            logger.debug("LSR batch fetch failed (non-fatal): %s", e)
+
+        try:
+            primary_name, batched = await provider.prepare_live_derivatives()
+            # Registry-wide targets are affordable only with batch acquisition.
+            target = (_perp_target_set(primary_name, symbols) if batched
+                      else list(dict.fromkeys(s for s in (symbols or []) if s)))
+            result = await provider.get_live_derivatives(
+                target, batched=batched, lsr_map=lsr_map,
+                top_position_map=top_position_map,
+            )
+            funding = result["funding"]
+            oi = result["open_interest"]
+            for snapshot in oi:
+                current = snapshot.model_dump()
+                fact = derivatives_facts.project_snapshot(current, "open_interest")[0]
+                delta = derivatives_facts._open_interest_change(
+                    current, fact, include_comparison=False,
+                )["value"]
+                snapshot.oi_change_1h_pct = delta * 100 if delta is not None else None
+            errors.extend(result["errors"])
+
+        finally:
+            await provider.close()
+
+        return {
+            "funding": funding,
+            "open_interest": oi,
+            "errors": errors,
+        }
+
+    async def collect_comparison(self, cfg) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Keep comparison workset/lifecycle separate from primary snapshot writes."""
+        from aletheia.data.ccxt_provider import get_market_data_provider
+
+        workset = comparison_workset(cfg)
+        acquired = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        result = dict(funding=[], open_interest=[], prices=[], errors=[],
+                      coverage={"acquired_at": acquired.isoformat(), "venues": {}})
+
+        async def collect_venue(venue, symbols):
+            provider = get_market_data_provider(
+                exchange=venue, native_ccxt=True, fallback_exchange=venue,
+            )
+            try:
+                part = await provider.get_derivatives_comparison(
+                    symbols, owns_primary=venue == cfg.market_data.ccxt_exchange,
+                    acquired=acquired,
+                )
+                for family in ("funding", "open_interest", "prices", "errors"):
+                    result[family].extend(part[family])
+                result["coverage"]["venues"][venue] = part["coverage"]
+            finally:
+                await provider.close()
+
+        await asyncio.gather(*(collect_venue(venue, symbols) for venue, symbols in workset.items()))
+        return result
+
+    async def collect_history(self, symbols: list[str]) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Best-effort sparse history backfill outside the live Funding/OI path."""
+        from aletheia.data.ccxt_provider import get_market_data_provider
+        from aletheia.config.loader import load_config
+
+        cfg = load_config()
+        history_hours = getattr(cfg.market_data, "derivatives_history_hours", 0)
+        if history_hours <= 0:
+            return {"errors": []}
+
+        provider = get_market_data_provider(native_ccxt=True)
+        errors: list[str] = []
+        funding_count = 0
+        oi_count = 0
+        already_current = 0
+        empty: list[str] = []
+        try:
+            primary_name, supported = await provider.prepare_derivatives_history(symbols)
+            for sym in dict.fromkeys(symbols):
+                if sym not in supported:
+                    errors.append(f"history_unsupported {sym}")
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    inserted, current = await _maybe_backfill_funding_history(
+                        provider, sym, primary_name, history_hours,
+                        errors=errors,
+                    )
+                    funding_count += inserted
+                    already_current += current
+                    if not inserted and not current:
+                        empty.append(f"funding_history_empty {sym}")
+                except Exception as exc:
+                    errors.append(f"funding_history {sym}: {exc}")
+                try:
+                    inserted, current = await _maybe_backfill_oi_history(
+                        provider, sym, primary_name, history_hours,
+                        errors=errors,
+                    )
+                    oi_count += inserted
+                    already_current += current
+                    if not inserted and not current:
+                        empty.append(f"oi_history_empty {sym}")
+                except Exception as exc:
+                    errors.append(f"oi_history {sym}: {exc}")
+        finally:
+            await provider.close()
+        if funding_count or oi_count or already_current:
+            errors.extend(empty)
+        return {
+            "funding": funding_count,
+            "open_interest": oi_count,
+            "already_current": already_current,
+            "errors": errors,
+        }
+
+
+def comparison_workset(cfg) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
+    """Registry and configured/open-position instruments, never Candidate ranking."""
+    from aletheia.storage import repositories as repo
+    from aletheia.trading.instruments import observed_instruments_from_config
+    configured = observed_instruments_from_config(cfg)
+    required = {item.symbol for item in configured if item.market_type == 'perp'}
+    required.update(row['symbol'] for row in repo.list_all_open_positions() if row.get('market_type') in {'perp', 'usdt_futures'})
+    venues = list(dict.fromkeys(cfg.market_data.derivatives_comparison_venues))
+    for venue in dict.fromkeys([cfg.market_data.ccxt_exchange, *venues]):
+        required.update(row['symbol'] for row in repo.list_universe_assets(venue=venue, active_only=True, limit=None)
+            if row.get('market_type') == 'perp')
+    return {venue: sorted(required) for venue in venues}
+
+
+def _perp_target_set(venue: str, extra_symbols: list[str] | None) -> list[str]:
+    """Canonical perp symbols to enrich on ``venue``: every active registry perp
+    plus any explicitly-passed symbol (open positions we must keep funding for
+    even if they rotated out of the universe), de-duplicated in insertion order.
+
+    Covering the whole perp universe — not just the active universe members — is
+    what gives the feature/scanner path OI + oi_delta for every candidate.
+    """
+    from aletheia.storage import repositories as repo
+
+    seen: dict[str, None] = {}
+    try:
+        for asset in repo.list_universe_assets(venue=venue, active_only=True, limit=None):
+            if (asset.get("market_type") or "") == "perp" and asset.get("symbol"):
+                seen.setdefault(str(asset["symbol"]), None)
+    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — registry read is best-effort
+        logger.debug("registry perp lookup failed (%s); using passed symbols only", e)
+    for s in extra_symbols or []:
+        if s:
+            seen.setdefault(str(s), None)
+    return list(seen)
+
+
+def _insert_historical_funding_snapshot(snapshot: FundingRateSnapshot) -> int:
+    """Store an observed historical rate; do not invent a subsequent settlement."""
+    from aletheia.storage.repositories import _select_all, insert_funding_rate_snapshot, LEGACY_DERIVATIVES_WHERE
+
+    observed_at = snapshot.observed_at
+    prior = _select_all(
+        "funding_rate_snapshots",
+        where=f"symbol=? AND exchange=? AND observed_at=? AND next_funding_time=? AND {LEGACY_DERIVATIVES_WHERE}",
+        params=(snapshot.symbol, snapshot.exchange, observed_at, observed_at), limit=1,
+    )
+    if prior:
+        return 0
+    snapshot.next_funding_time = observed_at
+    insert_funding_rate_snapshot(snapshot.model_dump())
+    return 1
+
+
+async def _maybe_backfill_funding_history(
+    provider, sym: str, exchange_name: str, since_hours: int,
+    errors: list[str] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[int, bool]:
+    """Core sparse-window policy and canonical history writer."""
+    from aletheia.storage.repositories import _select_all, LEGACY_DERIVATIVES_WHERE
+    cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=since_hours)).isoformat()
+    existing = _select_all(
+        "funding_rate_snapshots",
+        where=f"symbol=? AND exchange=? AND observed_at>? AND {LEGACY_DERIVATIVES_WHERE}",
+        params=(sym, exchange_name, cutoff), limit=3,
+    )
+    if len(existing) >= 3:
+        return 0, True
+    snapshots, acquisition_errors = await provider.get_funding_history(sym)
+    if any(snap.symbol != sym or snap.exchange != exchange_name for snap in snapshots):
+        raise ValueError("funding_history_identity_mismatch")
+    if errors is not None:
+        errors.extend(code for code in acquisition_errors if code not in errors)
+    return sum(_insert_historical_funding_snapshot(snap) for snap in snapshots), False
+
+
+async def _maybe_backfill_oi_history(
+    provider, sym: str, exchange_name: str, since_hours: int,
+    errors: list[str] | None = None,
+) -> tuple[int, bool]:
+    """Core sparse-window policy and exact-venue deduplicated history writer."""
+    from aletheia.storage.repositories import _select_all, insert_open_interest_snapshot, LEGACY_DERIVATIVES_WHERE
+    cutoff = (datetime.now(timezone.utc) - timedelta(hours=since_hours)).isoformat()
+    existing = _select_all(
+        "open_interest_snapshots",
+        where=f"symbol=? AND exchange=? AND observed_at>? AND {LEGACY_DERIVATIVES_WHERE}",
+        params=(sym, exchange_name, cutoff), limit=3,
+    )
+    if len(existing) >= 3:
+        return 0, True
+    snapshots, acquisition_errors = await provider.get_open_interest_history(sym)
+    if any(snap.symbol != sym or snap.exchange != exchange_name for snap in snapshots):
+        raise ValueError("oi_history_identity_mismatch")
+    if errors is not None:
+        errors.extend(code for code in acquisition_errors if code not in errors)
+    n = 0
+    for snap in snapshots:
+        prior = _select_all(
+            "open_interest_snapshots",
+            where=f"symbol=? AND exchange=? AND observed_at=? AND {LEGACY_DERIVATIVES_WHERE}",
+            params=(sym, exchange_name, snap.observed_at), limit=1,
+        )
+        if prior:
+            continue
+        insert_open_interest_snapshot(snap.model_dump())
+        n += 1
+    return n, False

+def _classify_risk_regime(
+    vix: float | None, cap_change: float | None
+) -> str | None:
+    """Simple heuristic: VIX > 25 or cap down > 3% → risk_off; VIX < 15 + cap up → risk_on."""
+    if vix is None and cap_change is None:
+        return None
+    if vix is not None and vix > 25:
+        return "risk_off"
+    if cap_change is not None and cap_change < -3.0:
+        return "risk_off"
+    if vix is not None and vix < 15 and (cap_change is None or cap_change > 0):
+        return "risk_on"
+    return "neutral"

+"""Core persistence policy for confirmed market candles, independent of transport."""

+from aletheia.data.providers import Candle
+
+
+def persist_closed_candles(
+    canon: str,
+    timeframe: str,
+    candles: list[Candle],
+    exchange: str,
+    market_type: str = "spot",
+    *,
+    provider: str,
+) -> None:
+    """Persist confirmed bars; callers decide whether a failed write is optional."""
+    closed_candles = [candle for candle in candles if candle.is_closed]
+    if not closed_candles:
+        return
+    from aletheia.storage.repositories import upsert_ohlcv_candles
+
+    upsert_ohlcv_candles(
+        symbol=canon, timeframe=timeframe, candles=closed_candles,
+        provider=provider, exchange=exchange, market_type=market_type,
+    )

+def claim_observed_tpsl_close(
+    position_id: str,
+    *,
+    execute_order_id: str,
+    reason: str,
+    expected_account,
+):
+    """Atomically register an observed Bitget TPSL execution without placing it."""
+    from aletheia.storage import repositories as repo
+
+    execute_order_id = str(execute_order_id or "").strip()
+    if not execute_order_id:
+        raise ValueError("TPSL execute order identity unavailable")
+    with repo.transaction(immediate=True):
+        position = repo._select_one("positions", position_id)
+        if position is None or position.get("status") != "open":
+            return None, False
+        execution_mode = position.get("execution_mode")
+        # The observing reader is built from current configuration, but the claim
+        # carries the entry Order's frozen identity. Only a reader authenticating
+        # as exactly that account may produce or advance this claim; reconcile()
+        # rejects the same mismatch, and this bridge must not be the softer door.
+        entry_account = _position_account(position)
+        if expected_account is None or entry_account != expected_account:
+            raise ValueError("uta_account_identity_mismatch")
+        pending_id = position.get("pending_close_order_id")
+        if pending_id:
+            existing = repo.get_order(pending_id)
+            if (
+                existing is not None
+                and existing.get("exchange_order_id") == execute_order_id
+                and existing.get("position_id") == position_id
+            ):
+                # A claim written before this account proof existed carries a NULL
+                # identity, and materialize_bitget_close enforces none of its own.
+                # Advancing it would file evidence under absent or foreign
+                # provenance, so the carrier proves itself or the claim waits.
+                try:
+                    claimed = UTAAccountIdentity.model_validate_json(
+                        existing.get("uta_account_identity_json") or ""
+                    )
+                except ValueError as exc:
+                    raise ValueError("uta_account_identity_unavailable") from exc
+                if claimed != entry_account:
+                    raise ValueError("uta_account_identity_mismatch")
+                return existing, False
+            raise RuntimeError("TPSL execute order conflicts with pending close claim")
+
+        close_order = Order(
+            uta_account_identity_json=entry_account.model_dump_json(),
+            proposal_id=position.get("proposal_id"),
+            client_order_id=f"close-{position_id}",
+            position_id=position_id,
+            close_reason=reason,
+            symbol=position["symbol"],
+            market_type=position["market_type"],
+            direction=position["direction"],
+            order_type="market",
+            quantity=float(position["quantity"]),
+            price=None,
+            execution_mode=execution_mode,
+            exchange_order_id=execute_order_id,
+            status="materialization_missing",
+            error_reason="private_fill_evidence_pending",
+        )
+        repo.insert_order(close_order)
+        repo.claim_position_close(
+            position_id,
+            order_id=close_order.id,
+            status="materialization_missing",
+            requested_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+        )
+        return repo.get_order(close_order.id), True
+

+def materialize_observed_close_chain(
+    position: dict,
+    evidence: VerifiedExitResult,
+    *,
+    reason: str,
+) -> list[str]:
+    """Persist exact read-only exchange close facts inside the close transaction.
+
+    A disappearance query observes an already-completed exchange action; it does
+    not authorize or submit a new one.  Therefore an unknown remote Order is
+    stored as ``source='adopted'`` and every Fill keeps its account-scoped venue
+    identity.  Any conflicting local row aborts the whole Position close.
+    """
+    grouped: dict[str, list] = {}
+    for item in evidence.fills:
+        remote_order_id = str(item.order_id or "").strip()
+        if not remote_order_id:
+            raise ValueError("observed close requires exact remote Order identity")
+        grouped.setdefault(remote_order_id, []).append(item)
+
+    db = repo.get_db()
+    materialized_order_ids: list[str] = []
+    for remote_order_id, items in grouped.items():
+        remote_quantity = sum(float(item.quantity) for item in items)
+        quantity_tolerance = max(1e-12, remote_quantity * 1e-9)
+        matches = db.execute(
+            "SELECT * FROM orders WHERE execution_mode=? AND exchange_order_id=? "
+            "ORDER BY rowid ASC",
+            (evidence.execution_mode, remote_order_id),
+        ).fetchall()
+        if len(matches) > 1:
+            raise ValueError("remote close Order identity is ambiguous locally")
+
+        if matches:
+            order = dict(matches[0])
+            expected = {
+                "symbol": str(position["symbol"]),
+                "market_type": str(position["market_type"]),
+                "direction": str(position["direction"]),
+                "execution_mode": str(position["execution_mode"]),
+            }
+            if any(str(order.get(key) or "") != value for key, value in expected.items()):
+                raise ValueError("observed close Order identity conflicts with Position")
+            if order.get("proposal_id") != position.get("proposal_id"):
+                raise ValueError("observed close Order Proposal conflicts with Position")
+            linked_position_id = str(order.get("position_id") or "")
+            pending_owner = position.get("pending_close_order_id") == order["id"]
+            if linked_position_id not in {"", str(position["id"])}:
+                raise ValueError("observed close Order belongs to another Position")
+            if not str(order.get("close_reason") or "").strip() and not pending_owner:
+                raise ValueError("remote Order is not a proven local close Order")
+            order_quantity = float(order.get("quantity") or 0.0)
+            if abs(order_quantity - remote_quantity) > quantity_tolerance:
+                raise ValueError("observed close Order quantity conflicts with private fills")
+            local_order_id = str(order["id"])
+        else:
+            adopted = Order(
+                proposal_id=position.get("proposal_id"),
+                risk_decision_id=None,
+                position_id=str(position["id"]),
+                close_reason=reason,
+                symbol=str(position["symbol"]),
+                market_type=str(position["market_type"]),
+                direction=str(position["direction"]),
+                order_type="observed_close",
+                quantity=remote_quantity,
+                price=None,
+                execution_mode=str(position["execution_mode"]),
+                exchange_order_id=remote_order_id,
+                status="filled",
+                source="adopted",
+                filled_at=datetime.fromtimestamp(
+                    max(item.filled_at_ms for item in items) / 1000,
+                    tz=timezone.utc,
+                ).isoformat(),
+            )
+            repo.insert_order(adopted)
+            local_order_id = adopted.id
+
+        for item in items:
+            durable_id = durable_private_fill_id(
+                str(position["execution_mode"]), str(item.fill_id)
+            )
+            ids = (durable_id, str(item.fill_id))
+            existing_rows = db.execute(
+                "SELECT * FROM fills WHERE id IN (?, ?) ORDER BY rowid ASC",
+                ids,
+            ).fetchall()
+            if len(existing_rows) > 1:
+                raise ValueError("remote close Fill identity is duplicated locally")
+            filled_at = datetime.fromtimestamp(
+                item.filled_at_ms / 1000, tz=timezone.utc
+            ).isoformat()
+            if existing_rows:
+                existing = dict(existing_rows[0])
+                _fill_totals([existing], symbol=str(position["symbol"]))
+                price_tolerance = max(1e-12, float(item.price) * 1e-9)
+                fee_tolerance = max(1e-12, abs(item.fee) * 1e-9) if item.fee is not None else 0.0
+                if (
+                    str(existing.get("order_id") or "") != local_order_id
+                    or abs(float(existing.get("fill_price") or 0.0) - item.price)
+                    > price_tolerance
+                    or abs(float(existing.get("fill_quantity") or 0.0) - item.quantity)
+                    > quantity_tolerance
+                    or (existing.get("fee") is None) != (item.fee is None)
+                    or (item.fee is not None and abs(float(existing["fee"]) - item.fee) > fee_tolerance)
+                    or str(existing.get("fee_currency") or "").upper()
+                    != str(item.fee_currency or "").upper()

+                fill_quantity=float(item.quantity),

+                fee_currency=str(item.fee_currency or ""),
+                fee_source="reconciled" if item.fee is not None else "unavailable",
+                filled_at=filled_at,
+            ))
+
+        repo.transition_order(
+            local_order_id,
+            position_id=str(position["id"]),
+            status="filled",
+            error_reason=None,
+            filled_at=datetime.fromtimestamp(
+                max(item.filled_at_ms for item in items) / 1000,
+                tz=timezone.utc,
+            ).isoformat(),
+        )
+        materialized_order_ids.append(local_order_id)
+    return materialized_order_ids

+def _materialize_reconciled_order(
+    order: dict, rows, *, is_close_order: bool,
+    funding_ledger: dict | None, errors: list[str],
+) -> MaterializationResult | None:
+    """One native reconciliation materialization and failure-recording path."""
+    try:
+        return (
+            materialize_bitget_close(order["id"], rows, funding_ledger=funding_ledger)
+            if is_close_order
+            else materialize_bitget_entry(order["id"], rows)
+        )
+    except (MaterializationIntegrityError, ValueError) as exc:
+        errors.append(
+            f"{order['execution_mode']}/{order['market_type']}: local materialization rejected"
+        )
+        logger.warning(
+            "reconcile: materialization rejected for %s order %s (%s)",
+            order["execution_mode"], order["id"], type(exc).__name__,
+        )
+        _write_reconcile_event(
+            order, state=str(order.get("status") or "unresolved"),
+            reason="local_materialization_rejected",
+        )
+    except Exception as exc:
+        errors.append(
+            f"{order['execution_mode']}/{order['market_type']}: local materialization failed"
+        )
+        logger.warning(
+            "reconcile: materialization failed for %s order %s (%s)",
+            order["execution_mode"], order["id"], type(exc).__name__,
+        )
+        try:
+            transition_order(
+                order["id"], status="materialization_missing",
+                error_reason="exchange_fill_local_materialization_missing",
+                filled_at=None,
+            )
+        except Exception:
+            pass
+        _write_reconcile_event(
+            order, state="materialization_missing",
+            reason="local_materialization_failed",
+        )
+    return None

+    def apply_reviewed_lessons(self, lesson_ids: list[str]):
+        """Recheck accepted lessons and commit their policy linkage in one transaction."""
+        from aletheia.policies.store import PolicyStore
+
+        applied_ids = []
+        policy_store = PolicyStore()
+
+        with repo.transaction(immediate=True):
+            accepted_ids = []
+            for lesson_id in lesson_ids:
+                current = self.get(lesson_id)
+                if current is not None and current.status == "accepted":
+                    accepted_ids.append(lesson_id)
+            pending_ids = set(accepted_ids)
+            pv = None
+            versions = (
+                policy_store.list_versions("lesson_policy")
+                if accepted_ids else []
+            )
+            for version in versions:
+                version_ids = set(
+                    json.loads(version.policy_json).get("accepted_lesson_ids") or []
+                )
+                if version.status != "active" or not pending_ids.issubset(version_ids):
+                    continue
+                current_lessons = [self.get(lesson_id) for lesson_id in version_ids]
+                if all(
+                    lesson is not None
+                    and lesson.status in {"accepted", "applied"}
+                    for lesson in current_lessons
+                ):
+                    pv = version
+                    break
+            if pv is None and accepted_ids:
+                pv = policy_store.create_version(
+                    policy_type="lesson_policy",
+                    policy={
+                        "accepted_lesson_ids": accepted_ids,
+                        "reviewed_at": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+                        "basis": "settled outcomes, last 30d, 24h horizon",
+                    },
+                    created_by="lesson_reviewer",
+                )
+            if pv is not None:
+                applied_ids = [
+                    lesson_id for lesson_id in accepted_ids
+                    if self.mark_applied(lesson_id, pv.policy_version_id)
+                ]
+        return pv, applied_ids
+

+"""Read-only planning for historical outcome-integrity remediation."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import Counter
+import hashlib
+import json
+from typing import Any
+
+from aletheia.analytics.learning_window import (
+    CLEAN_WINDOW_ANCHOR_ID,
+    CLEAN_WINDOW_ANCHOR_ISO,
+)
+from aletheia.analytics.outcome_integrity import (
+    ADMINISTRATIVE_CLOSE_REASONS,
+    MAINTENANCE_CLOSE_REASONS,
+    OUTCOME_SEMANTICS_VERSION,
+)
+
+
+REMEDIATION_BATCH_ID = f"{CLEAN_WINDOW_ANCHOR_ID}:{OUTCOME_SEMANTICS_VERSION}"
+_DERIVED_ITEM_TYPES = frozenset({
+    "calibration_report",
+    "reasoning_feedback",
+    "trading_memo",
+    "operator_assessment",
+    "post_trade_review",
+    "trade_case_study",
+})
+
+
+def _plan_outcome_history(db):
+    classifications = _classification_plan(db)
+    archives = _archive_plan(db)
+    compensation_candidates = _compensation_candidates(db)
+    result = {
+        "batch_id": REMEDIATION_BATCH_ID,
+        "semantics_version": OUTCOME_SEMANTICS_VERSION,
+        "clean_window_anchor_id": CLEAN_WINDOW_ANCHOR_ID,
+        "clean_window_anchor_iso": CLEAN_WINDOW_ANCHOR_ISO,
+        "dry_run": True,
+        "classification": {
+            "planned": len(classifications),
+            "applied": 0,
+            "by_category": dict(sorted(Counter(
+                item["close_category"] for item in classifications
+            ).items())),
+        },
+        "archive": {
+            "planned": len(archives),
+            "applied": 0,
+            "by_type": dict(sorted(Counter(
+                item["item_type"] for item in archives
+            ).items())),
+        },
+        "compensation_candidates": compensation_candidates,
+        "owner_approval_required": True,
+        "rebuild_candidates": ["calibration_report", "reasoning_feedback"],
+    }
+    return result, classifications, archives
+
+
+def plan_outcome_history() -> dict[str, Any]:
+    from aletheia.storage.sqlite import read_snapshot
+
+    with read_snapshot() as db:
+        result, _, _ = _plan_outcome_history(db)
+    return result
+
+
+def _classification_plan(db) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    rows = db.execute(
+        "SELECT id, close_reason FROM positions WHERE status='closed' "
+        "AND outcome_semantics_version IS NULL ORDER BY id"
+    ).fetchall()
+    plan: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    for row in rows:
+        reason = str(row["close_reason"] or "").strip().lower()
+        if reason in ADMINISTRATIVE_CLOSE_REASONS:
+            category = "administrative"
+        elif reason in MAINTENANCE_CLOSE_REASONS:
+            category = "maintenance"
+        else:
+            continue
+        plan.append({
+            "id": str(row["id"]),
+            "close_category": category,
+            "outcome_exclusion_reason": f"{category}_close",
+        })
+    return plan
+
+
+def _archive_plan(db) -> list[dict[str, str]]:
+    placeholders = ",".join("?" for _ in _DERIVED_ITEM_TYPES)
+    rows = db.execute(
+        f"SELECT id,item_type,content,tags,created_at FROM knowledge_items "
+        f"WHERE status='active' AND item_type IN ({placeholders}) ORDER BY id",
+        tuple(sorted(_DERIVED_ITEM_TYPES)),
+    ).fetchall()
+    plan: list[dict[str, str]] = []
+    for row in rows:
+        reason = _derived_archive_reason(dict(row))
+        if reason:
+            plan.append({
+                "id": str(row["id"]),
+                "item_type": str(row["item_type"]),
+                "reason": reason,
+            })
+    return plan
+
+
+def _derived_archive_reason(row: dict[str, Any]) -> str | None:
+    created_at = str(row.get("created_at") or "")
+    if created_at and created_at < CLEAN_WINDOW_ANCHOR_ISO:
+        return "pre_clean_window_derived_artifact"
+    if row.get("item_type") == "operator_assessment":
+        return None
+    if row.get("item_type") in {"post_trade_review", "trade_case_study"}:
+        return None
+    try:
+        payload = json.loads(row.get("content") or "{}")
+    except (TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+        return "unreadable_derived_artifact"
+    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+        return "unreadable_derived_artifact"
+    if payload.get("outcome_semantics_version") != OUTCOME_SEMANTICS_VERSION:
+        return "unknown_semantics_version"
+    if payload.get("clean_window_anchor_id") != CLEAN_WINDOW_ANCHOR_ID:
+        return "unknown_clean_window_anchor"
+    return None
+
+
+def _compensation_candidates(db) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
+    rows = db.execute(
+        "SELECT e.id AS event_id,e.position_id,e.amount_usdt "
+        "FROM paper_account_events e JOIN positions p ON p.id=e.position_id "
+        "WHERE e.action='position_closed' AND ("
+        "p.close_reason IN ({}) OR p.close_category IN ('administrative','maintenance')) "
+        "ORDER BY e.id".format(",".join("?" for _ in (
+            ADMINISTRATIVE_CLOSE_REASONS | MAINTENANCE_CLOSE_REASONS
+        ))),
+        tuple(sorted(ADMINISTRATIVE_CLOSE_REASONS | MAINTENANCE_CLOSE_REASONS)),
+    ).fetchall()
+    return [{
+        "candidate_id": _candidate_id(str(row["event_id"])),
+        "position_id": str(row["position_id"]),
+        "paper_account_event_id": str(row["event_id"]),
+        "amount_usdt": round(-float(row["amount_usdt"]), 8),
+        "reason": "reverse_administrative_close_cash_effect",
+        "owner_approval_required": True,
+    } for row in rows]
+
+
+def _candidate_id(event_id: str) -> str:
+    return "oi-cash-" + hashlib.sha256(
+        f"{REMEDIATION_BATCH_ID}:{event_id}".encode()
+    ).hexdigest()[:24]

+"""Read-only diagnostics and shared selection for unobserved settlement rows.
+
+The explicitly invoked Ops repair owns requeue writes, not this Core reader.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+# Queues that share the one observation layer and therefore shared the defect.
+_TABLES = (
+    "filter_candidate_outcomes",
+    "universe_forward_outcomes",
+    "perp_structure_shadow_outcomes",
+)
+
+_UNOBSERVED = (
+    "status = 'failed' "
+    "AND exit_price_usd IS NULL "
+    "AND settlement_price_source IS NULL"
+)
+
+
+def count_unobserved_failed_outcomes() -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Per-table count of never-observed write-offs, for doctor and probes.
+
+    A non-zero count is not self-healing: these rows are terminal until this
+    Ops repair reclaims them.
+    """
+    from aletheia.storage.sqlite import get_db
+
+    db = get_db()
+    counts: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for table in _TABLES:
+        try:
+            counts[table] = int(
+                db.execute(
+                    f"SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM {table} WHERE {_UNOBSERVED}"
+                ).fetchone()["n"]
+            )
+        except Exception:
+            counts[table] = 0
+    return counts

+def load_eligible_position_for_delivery(position_id: str) -> tuple[dict | None, str]:
+    """Load/recover delivery eligibility under the close-economics owner."""
+    from aletheia.analytics.outcome_integrity import (
+        assess_reportable_outcome, attribution_chain_complete,
+    )
+    from aletheia.storage import repositories as repo
+    from aletheia.storage.models import AuditEvent
+
+    position = repo._select_one("positions", position_id)
+    if position is None:
+        return None, "position_not_found"
+    if position.get("execution_mode") == "paper_internal":
+        return None, "archived_execution_mode"
+    pending_attribution_recheck = (
+        not bool(position.get("outcome_eligible"))
+        and position.get("outcome_exclusion_reason") == "attribution_read_failed"
+    )
+    if pending_attribution_recheck:
+        # This marker means the close-time reader failed; it is not evidence that
+        # attribution is absent. Re-read and reclassify under one writer lock so
+        # the stored eligibility and the causal backlinks are one audited fact.
+        with repo.transaction(immediate=True):
+            current = repo._select_one("positions", position_id)
+            if current is None:
+                return None, "position_not_found"
+            if (
+                not bool(current.get("outcome_eligible"))
+                and current.get("outcome_exclusion_reason")
+                == "attribution_read_failed"
+            ):
+                assessment_input = {
+                    **current,
+                    "outcome_eligible": True,
+                    "outcome_exclusion_reason": "eligible",
+                }
+                prospective = {
+                    **assessment_input,
+                    "_attribution_complete": attribution_chain_complete(
+                        assessment_input
+                    ),
+                }
+                assessment = assess_reportable_outcome(prospective)
+                repo.update_closed_position_settlement(
+                    position_id,
+                    outcome_eligible=assessment.eligible,
+                    outcome_exclusion_reason=assessment.reason,
+                )
+                repo.insert_audit_event(AuditEvent(
+                    actor="outcome_hook_replay",
+                    source="outcome_attribution_recheck",
+                    event_type="outcome_eligibility_rechecked",
+                    entity_type="position",
+                    entity_id=position_id,
+                    before_state=json.dumps({
+                        "outcome_eligible": False,
+                        "outcome_exclusion_reason": "attribution_read_failed",
+                    }, sort_keys=True),
+                    after_state=json.dumps({
+                        "outcome_eligible": assessment.eligible,
+                        "outcome_exclusion_reason": assessment.reason,
+                    }, sort_keys=True),
+                    message=(
+                        "Retried close-time attribution and persisted the durable "
+                        f"Outcome eligibility result: {assessment.reason}"
+                    ),
+                ))
+                current = {
+                    **current,
+                    "outcome_eligible": assessment.eligible,
+                    "outcome_exclusion_reason": assessment.reason,
+                }
+                if not assessment.eligible:
+                    return None, assessment.reason
+                return prospective, "eligible"
+            position = current
+
+    prospective = {
+        **position,
+        "_attribution_complete": attribution_chain_complete(position),
+    }
+    assessment = assess_reportable_outcome(prospective)
+    if not assessment.eligible:
+        return None, assessment.reason
+    return prospective, "eligible"
+

diff --git a/core/aletheia/telegram/__init__.py b/core/aletheia/telegram/__init__.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..d9f5b77e4
--- /dev/null
+++ b/core/aletheia/telegram/__init__.py
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+"""Bounded optional Telegram transport binding, configured by entrypoints."""
+
+from collections.abc import Awaitable, Callable
+from typing import Protocol
+
+
+class TelegramTransport(Protocol):
+    allowed_chat_ids: set[int]
+
+    def configure(self) -> bool: ...
+    async def send_message(self, chat_id: int, text: str, *, parse_mode: str | None = "HTML") -> None: ...
+    async def run(self, poll_interval: float = 2.5) -> None: ...
+    def stop(self) -> None: ...
+
+
+_factory: Callable[[], TelegramTransport] | None = None
+_health: Callable[[], Awaitable[dict]] | None = None
+
+
+def configure_transport(
+    factory: Callable[[], TelegramTransport] | None,
+    health: Callable[[], Awaitable[dict]] | None,
+) -> None:
+    global _factory, _health
+    _factory, _health = factory, health
+
+
+def create_transport() -> TelegramTransport | None:
+    return _factory() if _factory is not None else None
+
+
+async def transport_health() -> dict:
+    if _health is None:
+        return {"reachable": False, "error": "adapter_unavailable"}
+    return await _health()
