@@ -0,0 +1,217 @@
+"""Core Telegram command authorization and operator actions; no transport credentials."""
+
+import asyncio
+import time
+
+from aletheia.config.loader import load_config
+from aletheia.files.jsonl import write_audit
+
+_KILL_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_SEC = 300.0  # 5 minutes to confirm kill
+
+
+class TelegramCommands:
+    """One command handler and confirmation state per polling session."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self._pending_kills: dict[int, float] = {}  # chat_id → monotonic timestamp
+
+    async def handle_message(self, chat_id: int, text: str) -> str | None:
+        """Handle a telegram command. Returns response text or None."""
+        cfg = await asyncio.to_thread(load_config, use_cache=False)
+        if not cfg.telegram.enabled:
+            auth_error = "Telegram is disabled."
+        elif not cfg.telegram.allowed_chat_ids:
+            auth_error = "Telegram is enabled but no allowed_chat_ids are configured."
+        elif chat_id not in cfg.telegram.allowed_chat_ids:
+            auth_error = "Unauthorized."
+        else:
+            auth_error = None
+        if auth_error:
+            write_audit({
+                "actor": "telegram",
+                "source": "telegram",
+                "event_type": "unauthorized_access",
+                "message": f"Unauthorized telegram message from chat_id={chat_id}",
+            })
+            return None
+
+        cmd = text.strip().lower()
+
+        if cmd == "/status":
+            return self._cmd_status()
+        elif cmd == "/pause":
+            return self._cmd_pause()
+        elif cmd == "/resume":
+            return await self._cmd_resume()
+        elif cmd == "/latest":
+            return self._cmd_latest()
+        elif cmd == "/positions":
+            return self._cmd_positions()
+        elif cmd == "/pnl":
+            return self._cmd_pnl()
+        elif cmd == "/kill":
+            return self._cmd_kill_request(chat_id)
+        elif cmd == "/kill confirm":
+            return self._cmd_kill_confirm(chat_id)
+        elif cmd in ("/help", "/start"):
+            return self._cmd_help()
+        else:
+            return "Unknown command. Try /help"
+
+    def _cmd_status(self) -> str:
+        cfg = load_config()
+        from aletheia.config.exchange_alignment import exchange_alignment
+        alignment = exchange_alignment(cfg)
+        execution_exchange = alignment.execution_exchange
+        exchange_label = (
+            f"{execution_exchange} ({cfg.exchange.mode})" if execution_exchange
+            else "Not configured" if alignment.status == "not_configured" else "Unavailable"
+        )
+        # Issue #1745: plain text; _handle_update sends with parse_mode=None.
+        return (
+            f"Gateway: running\n"
+            f"Paused: {cfg.runtime.paused}\n"
+            f"Exchange: {exchange_label}\n"
+            f"Live: {cfg.live.state}\n"
+            f"Permission: {cfg.agent.permission_mode}"
+        )
+
+    def _cmd_pause(self) -> str:
+        from aletheia.agent_runtime.pause_ownership import (
+            MANUAL_OWNER,
+            acquire_pause,
+            pause_acknowledgement,
+        )
+
+        acquire_pause(
+            MANUAL_OWNER,
+            reason="telegram_pause",
+            actor="telegram",
+            source="telegram",
+        )
+        write_audit({
+            "actor": "telegram",
+            "source": "telegram",
+            "event_type": "gateway_paused",
+            "message": "Paused via Telegram",
+        })
+        return f"Gateway paused. {pause_acknowledgement()['message']}"
+
+    async def _cmd_resume(self) -> str:
+        from aletheia.agent_runtime import resume_gate
+
+        gate = await resume_gate.resume_if_llm_available(
+            actor="telegram",
+            source="telegram",
+            cause="telegram_resume",
+        )
+        if not gate["allowed"]:
+            return f"Resume blocked: {resume_gate.summarize_resume_gate(gate)}"
+        write_audit({
+            "actor": "telegram",
+            "source": "telegram",
+            "event_type": "gateway_resumed",
+            "message": "Resumed via Telegram",
+        })
+        return "Gateway resumed."
+
+    def _cmd_latest(self) -> str:
+        from aletheia.storage.repositories import list_agent_runs
+        runs = list_agent_runs(limit=3)
+        if not runs:
+            return "No recent agent runs."
+        lines = []
+        for r in runs:
+            lines.append(f"- {r['agent_name']}: {r['status']} ({r['started_at'][:16]})")
+        return "Recent runs:\n" + "\n".join(lines)
+
+    def _cmd_positions(self) -> str:
+        try:
+            from aletheia.storage.repositories import list_positions
+            positions = list_positions(status="open")
+            if not positions:
+                return "No open positions."
+            lines = []
+            for p in positions[:10]:
+                direction = "L" if p["direction"] in ("long", "buy") else "S"
+                lines.append(
+                    f"{direction} {p['symbol']} x{p['quantity']:.4f} "
+                    f"@ {p['entry_price']:.4f} ({p.get('execution_mode', '?')[:6]})"
+                )
+            suffix = f"\n...+{len(positions)-10} more" if len(positions) > 10 else ""
+            return f"Open positions ({len(positions)}):\n" + "\n".join(lines) + suffix
+        except Exception as e:
+            return f"Error fetching positions: {e}"
+
+    def _cmd_pnl(self) -> str:
+        try:
+            from aletheia.analytics.execution_mode import resolve_selected_execution_mode
+            from aletheia.portfolio.pnl import compute_portfolio
+            execution_mode = resolve_selected_execution_mode()
+            if execution_mode is None:
+                return "Today PnL: unavailable (execution_mode_unresolved)."
+            portfolio = compute_portfolio(execution_mode=execution_mode)
+            realized = (
+                portfolio.get("today_realized_pnl")
+                if portfolio.get("today_realized_pnl_complete") is True
+                else None
+            )
+            unrealized = float(portfolio.get("unrealized_pnl") or 0.0)
+            if realized is None:
+                return (
+                    "Today PnL\n"
+                    "Realized: unavailable\n"
+                    f"Unrealized: {unrealized:+.2f} USDT\n"
+                    "Total: unavailable\n"
+                    "Funding or other close economics are incomplete."
+                )
+            sign = "+" if realized >= 0 else ""
+            return (
+                f"Today PnL\n"
+                f"Realized: {sign}{realized:.2f} USDT\n"
+                f"Unrealized: {unrealized:+.2f} USDT\n"
+                f"Total: {realized + unrealized:+.2f} USDT"
+            )
+        except Exception as e:
+            return f"Error fetching PnL: {e}"
+
+    def _cmd_kill_request(self, chat_id: int) -> str:
+        self._pending_kills[chat_id] = time.monotonic()
+        return (
+            "WARNING: This will activate the kill switch and halt all trading.\n"
+            "Reply /kill confirm within 5 minutes to proceed, or ignore to cancel."
+        )
+
+    def _cmd_kill_confirm(self, chat_id: int) -> str:
+        requested_at = self._pending_kills.pop(chat_id, None)
+        if requested_at is None:
+            return "No pending kill request. Send /kill first."
+        if time.monotonic() - requested_at > _KILL_CONFIRM_TIMEOUT_SEC:
+            return "Kill request expired (>5 min). Send /kill again."
+        try:
+            from aletheia.risk import kill_switch
+
+            kill_switch.activate(reason="telegram kill confirmation", actor="telegram")
+            write_audit({
+                "actor": "telegram",
+                "source": "telegram",
+                "event_type": "kill_switch_activated",
+                "message": f"Kill switch activated via Telegram by chat_id={chat_id}",
+            })
+            return "Kill switch ACTIVATED. All new trading halted."
+        except Exception as e:
+            return f"Failed to activate kill switch: {e}"
+
+    def _cmd_help(self) -> str:
+        # Issue #1745: plain text; no HTML markup needed.
+        return (
+            "Aletheia Trading OS\n\n"
+            "/status — System status\n"
+            "/pause — Pause new decisions/trading\n"
+            "/resume — Resume agents\n"
+            "/latest — Recent agent runs\n"
+            "/positions — Open positions\n"
+            "/pnl — Today PnL summary\n"
+            "/kill — Activate kill switch (2-step)\n"
+            "/help — This message"
+        )

         return created if new_candidates_only else result

+logger = logging.getLogger("aletheia.serenity_publication")
+_AUTO_PROMOTE_NOTIFY_LOCK = threading.Lock()
+_AUTO_PROMOTE_NOTIFY_RETRIES: set[str] = set()
+
+
+def auto_publish_serenity_candidates(
+    opportunity_ids: list[str],
+    *,
+    min_score_for_pi: float,
+) -> int:
+    """Atomically publish score-qualified Serenity Candidates by theme."""
+
+    theme_ids: set[str] = set()
+    for opportunity_id in opportunity_ids:
+        opp = repo.get_serenity_opportunity(opportunity_id)
+        if not opp or opp.get("status") != "active":
+            continue
+        theme_ids.add(str(opp["theme_id"]))
+
+    active_ids_by_theme: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
+    for theme_id in theme_ids:
+        active_siblings = repo.list_serenity_opportunities(
+            theme_id=theme_id, status="active", limit=1000
+        )
+        active_ids_by_theme[theme_id] = [str(opp["id"]) for opp in active_siblings]
+
+    promoted_count = 0
+    newly_queued_themes: set[str] = set()
+    for theme_id, active_ids in active_ids_by_theme.items():
+        try:
+            queued_ids = publish_serenity_candidates(
+                theme_id,
+                active_ids,
+                min_score_for_pi=min_score_for_pi,
+                new_candidates_only=True,
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            # A theme is one atomic unit. Keep it retryable while allowing an
+            # unrelated theme in the same research run to advance.
+            logger.warning(
+                "auto_promote theme %s rolled back (%s)",
+                theme_id,
+                type(exc).__name__,
+            )
+            continue
+        promoted_count += len(queued_ids)
+        if queued_ids:
+            newly_queued_themes.add(theme_id)
+
+    with _AUTO_PROMOTE_NOTIFY_LOCK:
+        retry_themes = set(theme_ids) & _AUTO_PROMOTE_NOTIFY_RETRIES
+    notify_themes = newly_queued_themes | retry_themes
+    if notify_themes:
+        from aletheia.agent_runtime.pi_daemon import notify_pi_daemon
+
+        try:
+            notify_pi_daemon(source="serenity_auto_promote")
+        except Exception:
+            with _AUTO_PROMOTE_NOTIFY_LOCK:
+                _AUTO_PROMOTE_NOTIFY_RETRIES.update(notify_themes)
+            logger.warning("Serenity auto-promote wake failed; retry retained")
+        else:
+            with _AUTO_PROMOTE_NOTIFY_LOCK:
+                _AUTO_PROMOTE_NOTIFY_RETRIES.difference_update(notify_themes)
+    return promoted_count

+"""Core fast-market event contract, monitoring projection and adapter binding."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import time
+from typing import Literal, Protocol
+
+from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict
+
+from aletheia.config.exchanges import EXCHANGE_UNIFICATION_MAP, LIVE_EXECUTION_MODES
+from aletheia.data.symbols import InstrumentId
+
+
+class FastMarketEvent(BaseModel):
+    model_config = ConfigDict(arbitrary_types_allowed=True, frozen=True)
+
+    event_type: Literal["quote", "trade", "depth", "candle"]
+    instrument: InstrumentId
+    exchange_timestamp_ms: int
+    received_timestamp_ms: int
+    sequence: int
+    stream_generation_id: str | None = None
+    subscription_generation_id: str | None = None
+    bid: float | None = None
+    ask: float | None = None
+    price: float | None = None
+    size: float | None = None
+    side: Literal["buy", "sell"] | None = None
+    bids: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...] = ()
+    asks: tuple[tuple[float, float], ...] = ()
+    candle: tuple[float, float, float, float, float] | None = None
+
+
+class FastStreamHealth(BaseModel):
+    connected: bool = False
+    subscriptions_confirmed: bool = False
+    reason: str | None = None
+    last_received_at_ms: int | None = None
+
+
+def events_share_generation(*events: FastMarketEvent) -> bool:
+    return len(
+        {
+            (event.stream_generation_id, event.subscription_generation_id)
+            for event in events
+        }
+    ) == 1
+
+
+class FastMarketStream(Protocol):
+    async def connect(self, instruments: set[InstrumentId] | None = None) -> None: ...
+    async def set_instruments(self, instruments: set[InstrumentId]) -> None: ...
+    def events(self) -> AsyncIterator[FastMarketEvent]: ...
+    def health(self) -> FastStreamHealth: ...
+    def monitoring_state(
+        self,
+        instrument: InstrumentId,
+        required_channels: tuple[str, ...],
+    ) -> dict: ...
+    async def close(self) -> None: ...
+
+
+_CHANNEL_FRESHNESS_MS = {
+    "quote": 2_000,
+    "trade": 3_000,
+    "depth": 2_000,
+    "candle": 120_000,
+}
+
+
+def _monitoring_projection(
+    *,
+    instrument: InstrumentId,
+    required_channels: tuple[str, ...],
+    connected: bool,
+    stream_generation_id: str | None,
+    subscription_generation_id: str | None,
+    channel_facts: dict[tuple[InstrumentId, str], FastMarketEvent],
+    reason: str | None,
+) -> dict:
+    now_ms = int(time.time() * 1_000)
+    channels: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    for channel in required_channels:
+        fact = channel_facts.get((instrument, channel))
+        if fact is None:
+            channels[channel] = {
+                "state": "unavailable" if not connected else "warming",
+                "last_exchange_at": None,
+                "last_received_at": None,
+                "last_sequence": None,
+                "reason": reason if not connected else "channel_event_not_observed",
+            }
+            continue
+        age_ms = now_ms - fact.received_timestamp_ms
+        fresh = 0 <= age_ms <= _CHANNEL_FRESHNESS_MS[channel]
+        channels[channel] = {
+            "state": "ready" if fresh else "degraded",
+            "last_exchange_at": fact.exchange_timestamp_ms,
+            "last_received_at": fact.received_timestamp_ms,
+            "last_sequence": fact.sequence,
+            "reason": None if fresh else "channel_event_stale",
+        }
+    states = {value["state"] for value in channels.values()}
+    state = (
+        "unavailable"
+        if not connected
+        else "ready"
+        if states == {"ready"}
+        else "degraded"
+        if "degraded" in states
+        else "warming"
+    )
+    return {
+        "version": "entry-plan-monitoring/v1",
+        "state": state,
+        "instrument": {
+            "exchange": instrument.exchange,
+            "symbol": instrument.symbol,
+            "market_type": instrument.market_type,
+        },
+        "stream_generation_id": stream_generation_id,
+        "subscription_generation_id": subscription_generation_id,
+        "required_channels": list(required_channels),
+        "channels": channels,
+        "updated_at": datetime.fromtimestamp(now_ms / 1_000, tz=timezone.utc).isoformat(),
+    }
+
+
+def _nonnegative_int(value: object) -> int | None:
+    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, str)):
+        return None
+    if isinstance(value, str) and (not value or not value.isascii() or not value.isdecimal()):
+        return None
+    number = int(value)
+    return number if 0 <= number <= 2**63 - 1 else None
+
+
+_FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS = {}
+
+
+def configure_fast_market_stream(execution_mode: str, factory, *, market_types: frozenset[str]) -> None:
+    """Bind an optional factory without constructing a client or starting tasks."""
+    if factory is None:
+        _FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS.pop(execution_mode, None)
+    else:
+        _FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS[execution_mode] = (factory, market_types)
+
+
+def execution_venue_for_mode(execution_mode: str) -> str:
+    """Resolve venue identity from the existing execution-mode authority map."""
+
+    mode = str(execution_mode or "")
+    for venue, (_, paper_mode) in EXCHANGE_UNIFICATION_MAP.items():
+        if mode == paper_mode or mode == LIVE_EXECUTION_MODES.get(venue):
+            return venue
+    return "unknown"
+
+
+def fast_market_stream_available(execution_mode: str) -> bool:
+    return str(execution_mode or "") in _FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS
+
+
+def fast_market_data_venue_for_config(cfg) -> str:
+    """Resolve trigger data from the selected external execution account."""
+
+    return execution_venue_for_mode(cfg.exchange.paper_execution_mode)
+
+
+def fast_market_stream_available_for_config(cfg) -> bool:
+    venue = fast_market_data_venue_for_config(cfg)
+    return any(execution_venue_for_mode(mode) == venue for mode in _FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS)
+
+
+def fast_market_data_unavailability_reason(
+    cfg,
+    venue: str,
+    market_type: str | None = None,
+) -> str | None:
+    """Return a stable token if the exact candidate instrument cannot be monitored.
+
+    Used as a shared exact-instrument invariant across Universe allocation, Entry Planner
+    admission, and Fast Trigger Watch validation. Returning a token (not None) means
+    no Fast Monitoring engine exists for the candidate's physical venue.
+
+    Stable tokens:
+    - ``FAST_TRIGGER_DISABLED``: Fast Monitoring is explicitly disabled.
+    - ``FAST_MARKET_DATA_VENUE_MISMATCH``: candidate venue differs from the
+      configured fast-monitoring venue.
+    - ``FAST_MARKET_DATA_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE``: no adapter covers the configured
+      monitoring venue or exact execution market.
+    """
+    if not getattr(cfg.fast_trigger, "enabled", True):
+        return "FAST_TRIGGER_DISABLED"
+    configured_venue = fast_market_data_venue_for_config(cfg)
+    if str(venue or "").lower() != configured_venue:
+        return "FAST_MARKET_DATA_VENUE_MISMATCH"
+    if not any(execution_venue_for_mode(mode) == configured_venue for mode in _FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS):
+        return "FAST_MARKET_DATA_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE"
+    if market_type is not None and not any(
+        execution_venue_for_mode(mode) == configured_venue
+        and str(market_type).lower() in supported
+        for mode, (_, supported) in _FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS.items()
+    ):
+        return "FAST_MARKET_DATA_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE"
+    return None
+
+
+def fast_market_stream_for_config(cfg) -> FastMarketStream:
+    """Build the configured exact-venue stream for paper or exchange execution."""
+
+    venue = fast_market_data_venue_for_config(cfg)
+    adapter_mode = next(
+        (mode for mode in _FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS if execution_venue_for_mode(mode) == venue),
+        None,
+    )
+    if adapter_mode is None:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"fast_trigger_stream_unavailable:{venue}")
+    return fast_market_stream_for_execution_mode(adapter_mode)
+
+
+def fast_market_stream_for_execution_mode(execution_mode: str) -> FastMarketStream:
+    adapter = _FAST_STREAM_ADAPTERS.get(str(execution_mode or ""))
+    if adapter is not None:
+        return adapter[0]()
+    venue = execution_venue_for_mode(execution_mode)
+    raise RuntimeError(f"fast_trigger_stream_unavailable:{venue}")

+"""Asset registry policy and publication from a normalized market catalog.
+
+When running in demo mode (e.g. okx_demo), the registry is narrowed to only
+symbols actually supported on the demo environment — no wasted scanning.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import logging
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from aletheia.config.schema import AletheiaConfig
+from aletheia.data.symbols import (
+    instrument_background_rejection_reason,
+)
+from aletheia.storage.models import UniverseAsset
+from aletheia.storage import repositories as repo
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("aletheia.universe.registry")
+
+
+async def _load_demo_whitelist(paper_execution_mode: str) -> frozenset | None:
+    """Load the demo symbol whitelist for the active execution mode.
+
+    Returns None if no demo filtering is needed (live mode or full-access demos).
+
+    The shared execution capability seam returns {"usdt_futures": frozenset,
+    "spot": frozenset}. Collapse to a single frozenset so callers can do
+    `symbol in whitelist`.
+    """
+    from aletheia.execution.venue_capabilities import fetch_venue_capabilities
+
+    markets = await fetch_venue_capabilities(paper_execution_mode)
+    if markets is None:
+        return None
+    return markets.get("usdt_futures", frozenset()) | markets.get("spot", frozenset())
+
+
+def _invalidate_stale_pipeline_data() -> None:
+    """Flush stale universe pipeline data after a venue/strategy change.
+
+    Expires active snapshots and cancels all pending forward outcomes so
+    downstream jobs (data_collectors, outcome_recorder) don't operate on
+    symbols that no longer exist on the active exchange.
+    """
+    repo.expire_universe_snapshots(market_type="crypto")
+    cancelled = repo.cancel_all_pending_forward_outcomes()
+    logger.info(
+        "Pipeline invalidated: snapshots superseded, %d pending outcomes cancelled",
+        cancelled,
+    )
+
+
+async def sync_registry(cfg: AletheiaConfig) -> int:
+    """Sync the universe_registry from the configured exchange.
+
+    Consumes normalized active USDT-quoted markets from the bound adapter.
+    When in demo mode with a restricted symbol set (e.g. OKX demo),
+    only symbols actually executable on demo are registered.
+
+    Returns count of assets upserted.
+    """
+    from aletheia.data.market_catalog import fetch_market_catalog
+
+    md = cfg.market_data
+    venue = md.ccxt_exchange
+    fallback_venue = md.ccxt_fallback or venue
+    assets: list[UniverseAsset] = []
+    sync_started_at = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+
+    # Load demo whitelist if applicable
+    demo_whitelist = await _load_demo_whitelist(cfg.exchange.paper_execution_mode)
+    if demo_whitelist is not None:
+        logger.info("Demo whitelist active: %d symbols for %s",
+                    len(demo_whitelist), cfg.exchange.paper_execution_mode)
+
+    catalog = await fetch_market_catalog(venue, fallback_venue)
+    include_futures = cfg.exchange.enabled_markets.get("usdt_futures", False)
+    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
+    for entry in catalog:
+        canonical = entry.symbol
+        market_type = entry.market_type
+        if market_type == "perp" and not include_futures:
+            continue
+        background = entry.background
+        if entry.excluded_crypto and background["asset_class"] == "crypto":
+            continue
+
+        # Demo whitelist filter: skip symbols not executable on demo
+        if demo_whitelist is not None and canonical not in demo_whitelist:
+            # US-14: was a silent continue. Debug-log so an unexpectedly empty
+            # demo universe (whitelist-format mismatch) is diagnosable.
+            logger.debug("demo_whitelist: skip %s (not executable on %s)",
+                         canonical, cfg.exchange.paper_execution_mode)
+            continue
+
+        config_blacklisted = canonical in cfg.universe.blacklist
+        support_reason = instrument_background_rejection_reason(
+            background,
+            symbol=canonical,
+            market_type=market_type,
+            venue=venue,
+        )
+        blacklisted = config_blacklisted or support_reason is not None
+        blacklist_reason = None
+        if config_blacklisted:
+            blacklist_reason = "config_blacklist"
+        elif support_reason:
+            blacklist_reason = support_reason
+
+        asset = UniverseAsset(
+            venue=venue,
+            market_type=market_type,
+            symbol=canonical,
+            base_asset=entry.base,
+            quote_asset=entry.quote,
+            status="active",
+            min_notional=entry.min_notional,
+            price_precision=entry.price_precision,
+            amount_precision=entry.amount_precision,
+            first_seen_at=now,
+            last_seen_at=now,
+            is_blacklisted=blacklisted,
+            blacklist_reason=blacklist_reason,
+            metadata=json.dumps(
+                {"instrument_background": background}, sort_keys=True
+            ),
+        )
+        assets.append(asset)
+
+    count, deactivated_other, deactivated_stale = repo.sync_universe_assets(
+        assets,
+        active_venue=venue,
+        stale_cutoff_iso=sync_started_at,
+    )
+    # Deactivate other venues' assets (exchange was switched)
+    if deactivated_other:
+        logger.info("Deactivated %d assets from other venues", deactivated_other)
+
+    # Deactivate symbols no longer seen on current venue
+    if deactivated_stale:
+        logger.info("Deactivated %d stale assets from %s", deactivated_stale, venue)
+
+    # If registry changed significantly, invalidate stale universe pipeline data
+    # so downstream jobs (data_collectors, outcome_recorder) don't operate on
+    # symbols that no longer exist on the active exchange.
+    if deactivated_other or deactivated_stale:
+        _invalidate_stale_pipeline_data()
+
+    # Always invalidate the venue listing cache after a registry sync so that
+    # the next market_data / price_feed cycle re-fetches the current whitelist.
+    # This covers both exchange switches (deactivated_other) and routine
+    # delistings (deactivated_stale), as well as a first-time sync where
+    # neither counter is non-zero but the cache may be cold.
+    try:
+        from aletheia.data.venue_listing_cache import invalidate_venue_listing
+        invalidate_venue_listing(venue)
+    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — cache invalidation is best-effort
+        pass
+
+    logger.info("Registry sync: %d active assets from %s", count, venue)
+    return count

+async def probe_public_connectivity(venue: str) -> dict:
+    """Read public reachability only; it never proves account/trading capability."""
+    if _public_connectivity_probe is None:
+        return {"reachable": False, "latency_ms": None,
+                "error": "exchange_extension_unavailable", "exchange": venue}
+    try:
+        result = await _public_connectivity_probe(venue)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return {"reachable": False, "latency_ms": None,
+                "error": type(exc).__name__, "exchange": venue}
+    latency = result.get("latency_ms") if isinstance(result, dict) else None
+    error = result.get("error") if isinstance(result, dict) else None
+    valid_latency = (
+        type(latency) in (int, float) and math.isfinite(latency) and latency >= 0
     )
-    return (
-        (secret_and_config + profile_generation)
-        * (secret_and_config + profile_generation + 1)
-        // 2
-        + profile_generation
+    valid_failure = (
+        error == "exchange_probe_unavailable" and latency is None
+    ) or (
+        isinstance(error, str) and error.startswith("HTTP ")
+        and error[5:].isdigit() and 100 <= int(error[5:]) <= 599
+        and valid_latency
     )
+    if (
+        not isinstance(result, dict)
+        or type(result.get("reachable")) is not bool
+        or result.get("exchange") != venue
+        or "error" not in result
+        or "latency_ms" not in result
+        or (result["reachable"] and (
+            result["error"] is not None
+            or not valid_latency
+        ))
+        or (not result["reachable"] and not valid_failure)
+    ):
+        return {"reachable": False, "latency_ms": None,
+                "error": "invalid_exchange_probe_result", "exchange": venue}
+    return {key: result[key] for key in ("reachable", "latency_ms", "error", "exchange")}

+    """Validate an adapter profile and return the accounts sharing that setting."""
+    if _profile_accounts is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("exchange_extension_unavailable")
+    modes = _profile_accounts(field, value)
+    if not modes or any(mode not in UTA_EXECUTION_MODES for mode in modes):
+        raise ValueError("invalid_profile_account_identity")
+    return tuple(dict.fromkeys(modes))
+
+
+def credential_configuration(execution_mode: str, cfg=None) -> tuple[int, int] | None:
+    """Return configured/required counts for one account, never credential values."""
+    if _credential_configuration is None:
+        return None
+    configured, required = _credential_configuration(cfg, execution_mode)
+    if not (type(configured) is int and type(required) is int and 0 <= configured <= required and required > 0):
+        raise ValueError("invalid_credential_configuration_counts")
+    return configured, required
+

+def configuration_diagnostic(cfg) -> tuple[str, bool, str] | None:
+    """Read the optional adapter's configuration note; never grant startup authority."""
+    if _configuration_diagnostic is None:
+        return None
+    try:
+        return _configuration_diagnostic(cfg)
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return "exchange_configuration", False, f"configuration diagnostic unavailable: {type(exc).__name__}"

+"""binance private funding bill normalization for UTA."""

+from typing import Iterable, Mapping
+
+from aletheia.uta.funding import _deduplicate, _event
+
+
+def normalize_binance_funding_rows(rows: Iterable[Mapping]) -> list[dict]:
+    return _deduplicate(
+        _event(
+            row.get("tranId"), row.get("symbol"), row.get("income"),
+            row.get("asset"), row.get("time"), row.get("incomeType"),
+        )

+        if str(row.get("incomeType") or "") == "FUNDING_FEE"
+    )

+"""binance public instrument metadata decoding; no clients or persistence."""
+
+from aletheia.data.symbols import build_instrument_background, stock_token_to_ticker, to_canonical
+
+
+def decode_instrument_background(*, symbol: str, market_type: str, market_info: dict) -> dict:
+    canonical = to_canonical(symbol)
+    base, _, quote = canonical.partition("/")
+    raw = market_info.get("info") or {}
+    underlying_type = str(raw.get("underlyingType") or "").upper()
+    contract_type = str(raw.get("contractType") or "").upper()
+    subtypes = raw.get("underlyingSubType") or []
+    if not isinstance(subtypes, list):
+        subtypes = [subtypes]
+    subtypes = [str(value) for value in subtypes]
+    raw_base = str(market_info.get("base") or base)
+    raw_quote = str(market_info.get("quote") or quote)
+    stock_ticker = stock_token_to_ticker(f"{raw_base}/{raw_quote}")
+    default_crypto = market_type == "spot"
+    if stock_ticker or underlying_type.endswith("EQUITY"):
+        asset_class = "equity"
+    elif underlying_type in {"COMMODITY", "INDEX"}:
+        asset_class = underlying_type.lower()
+    elif underlying_type:
+        asset_class = "crypto" if underlying_type == "COIN" else "unknown"
+    else:
+        asset_class = "crypto" if default_crypto else "unknown"
+    return build_instrument_background(
+        symbol=symbol, venue="binance", market_type=market_type,
+        asset_class=asset_class, stock_ticker=stock_ticker,
+        classification={
+            "source": (
+                "exchange_metadata"
+                if underlying_type or stock_ticker
+                else "supported_market_default" if default_crypto else "unresolved"
+            ),
+            "underlying_type": underlying_type or None,
+            "contract_type": contract_type or None,
+            "underlying_subtypes": subtypes,
+        },
+    )

+"""Binance public taker ratio normalization."""
+
+from aletheia.data.derivatives_facts import finite
+
+
+async def read_taker(exchange, instrument):
+    rows = await exchange.fapipublic_get_takerlongshortratio({
+        "symbol": instrument.symbol.replace("/", ""), "period": "1h", "limit": 1,
+    })
+    value = finite(rows[0].get("buySellRatio")) if rows else None
+    return value if value is not None and value > 0 else None

+"""Public Binance positioning enrichment; bounded, independent of primary OI."""
+
+import asyncio
+import logging
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+
+from aletheia.net import httpx_client
+from extensions.exchanges.ccxt.derivatives_metadata import provider_source_time
+from aletheia.data.derivatives_facts import finite
+
+logger = logging.getLogger("aletheia.data.collectors.derivatives")
+
+# Binance Futures globalLongShortAccountRatio — public, no API key.
+# Scope: USDT-margined linear perpetuals only (BTC/USDT → BTCUSDT). Inverse perps
+# would need a different symbol form; deliberately out of scope this batch.
+# Fed into OpenInterestSnapshot.long_short_ratio at write time; normalizer's
+# compute_leverage_state already consumes long_short_ratio into crowding_score.
+_BINANCE_LSR_URL = "https://fapi.binance.com/futures/data/globalLongShortAccountRatio"
+_BINANCE_TOP_POSITION_RATIO_URL = (
+    "https://fapi.binance.com/futures/data/topLongShortPositionRatio"
+)
+# LSR enriches OI but is not allowed to consume the primary venue's live
+# Funding/OI budget.  A partial result is honest and remains useful.
+_LSR_BUDGET_SEC = 4.0
+
+
+async def fetch_positioning(symbols: list[str], family: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    url = {"global_account_ratio": _BINANCE_LSR_URL,
+           "top_position_ratio": _BINANCE_TOP_POSITION_RATIO_URL}[family]
+    return await _fetch_binance_ratio_batch(symbols, url)
+
+
+async def _fetch_binance_ratio_batch(symbols: list[str], url: str) -> dict[str, dict]:
+    results: dict[str, dict] = {}
+    semaphore = asyncio.Semaphore(4)
+    # Four requests per stream, eight combined; CCXT remains sequential.
+    async with httpx_client(timeout=_LSR_BUDGET_SEC) as client:
+        async def fetch(sym: str) -> None:
+            async with semaphore:
+                try:
+                    resp = await client.get(
+                        url,
+                        params={"symbol": sym.replace("/", ""), "period": "1h", "limit": 1},
+                    )
+                    if resp.status_code != 200:
+                        return
+                    items = resp.json()
+                    if isinstance(items, list) and items:
+                        ratio = finite(items[0].get("longShortRatio"))
+                        if ratio is not None and ratio > 0:
+                            acquired = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+                            source, status = provider_source_time(items[0], acquired)
+                            results[sym] = dict(value=ratio, provider="binance_public", venue="binance", source_observed_at=source,
+                                source_time_status=status, acquired_at=acquired.isoformat(),
+                                instrument=dict(canonical_symbol=sym, source_instrument_id=sym.replace('/', ''),
+                                    market_type='perp', base_asset=sym.split('/')[0],
+                                    quote_asset=sym.split('/')[-1], settle_asset='USDT', linear=sym.endswith('/USDT')))
+                except Exception as exc:
+                    logger.debug("Ratio fetch failed for %s: %s", sym, exc)
+
+        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(fetch(sym)) for sym in dict.fromkeys(symbols)]
+        try:
+            if tasks:
+                await asyncio.wait(tasks, timeout=_LSR_BUDGET_SEC)
+        finally:
+            for task in tasks:
+                if not task.done():
+                    task.cancel()
+            await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
+    return results

+"""Active Bitget Exchange Extension composition for the Core UTA port."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from aletheia.data.symbols import to_bitget
+from aletheia.uta.manager import (
+    NativeProtectionHistory,
+    NativeProtectionReader,
+    configure_uta_provider,
+)
+from aletheia.uta.models import FillReport, UTAAccountIdentity
+from extensions.exchanges.bitget import client as bitget_client
+from extensions.exchanges.bitget.auth import (
+    probe_candidate_credentials as _probe_candidate_credentials,
+)
+from extensions.exchanges import composition as ccxt_manager
+
+
+class _BitgetNativeProtectionReader:
+    def __init__(self, identity: UTAAccountIdentity):
+        self.identity = identity
+        self._client = bitget_client.BitgetClient(
+            mode=identity.environment,
+            profile=identity.profile,
+        )
+
+    async def get_plan_order_history(self, *, order_id: str) -> NativeProtectionHistory:
+        rows = await self._client.get_plan_order_history(order_id=order_id)
+        execute_order_ids = tuple(
+            str(row.get("executeOrderId") or "").strip()
+            for row in rows
+            if isinstance(row, dict)
+            and str(row.get("orderId") or "").strip() == order_id
+            and str(row.get("planStatus") or "").lower() == "executed"
+            and str(row.get("executeOrderId") or "").strip()
+        )
+        return NativeProtectionHistory(
+            identity=self.identity,
+            plan_order_id=order_id,
+            execute_order_ids=execute_order_ids,
+        )
+
+    async def get_order_fill_reports(
+        self,
+        *,
+        order_id: str,
+        symbol: str,
+        market_type: str,
+        identity: UTAAccountIdentity,
+    ) -> tuple[FillReport, ...]:
+        if identity != self.identity:
+            raise ValueError("uta_account_identity_mismatch")
+        reports = await self._client.get_order_fill_reports(
+            order_id=order_id,
+            symbol=to_bitget(symbol),
+            market_type=market_type,
+            identity=identity,
+        )
+        if any(report.identity != identity for report in reports):
+            raise ValueError("uta_account_identity_mismatch")
+        return tuple(reports)
+
+    async def close(self) -> None:
+        await self._client.close()
+
+
+def create_native_protection_reader(
+    execution_mode: str,
+    *,
+    expected_account: UTAAccountIdentity | None = None,
+    cfg=None,
+) -> NativeProtectionReader:
+    identity = expected_account or ccxt_manager.resolve_uta_identity(cfg, execution_mode)
+    if identity.execution_mode != execution_mode or identity.venue != "bitget":
+        raise ValueError("native_protection_unavailable")
+    return _BitgetNativeProtectionReader(identity)
+
+
+def register_uta_provider() -> None:
+    """Register the active Bitget extension through the Core UTA port."""
+    from aletheia.execution.order_constraints import configure_order_constraint_reader
+    from aletheia.execution.venue_capabilities import configure_market_capability_reader
+    from extensions.exchanges.ccxt.order_constraints import read_order_constraints
+    from extensions.exchanges.bitget.profile_config import configuration_diagnostic, profile_accounts
+
+    configure_order_constraint_reader(read_order_constraints)
+    configure_market_capability_reader(
+        ccxt_manager.fetch_market_restrictions, ccxt_manager.cached_market_restrictions
+    )
+    configure_uta_provider(
+        registry_factory=ccxt_manager.build_uta_registry,
+        funding_history_retention_contract=ccxt_manager.funding_history_retention_contract,
+        identity_resolver=ccxt_manager.resolve_uta_identity,
+        native_protection_reader_factory=create_native_protection_reader,
+        candidate_credential_probe=_probe_candidate_credentials,
+        configuration_diagnostic=configuration_diagnostic,
+        credential_configuration=ccxt_manager.credential_configuration,
+        profile_accounts=profile_accounts,
+        public_connectivity_probe=ccxt_manager.probe_public_connectivity,
+    )

+"""Credential-free Bitget fast-market stream adapter."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from collections.abc import AsyncIterator
+import json
+import time
+from uuid import uuid4
+
+import aiohttp
+
+from aletheia.data.symbols import InstrumentId
+from aletheia.universe.fast_stream import (
+    FastMarketEvent, FastStreamHealth, _CHANNEL_FRESHNESS_MS,
+    _monitoring_projection, _nonnegative_int,
+)
+
+_BITGET_PUBLIC_WS = "wss://ws.bitget.com/v2/ws/public"
+_CHANNELS = ("ticker", "trade", "books5", "candle1m")
+
+
+def _bitget_arg(instrument: InstrumentId, channel: str) -> dict[str, str]:
+    return {
+        "instType": "SPOT" if instrument.market_type == "spot" else "USDT-FUTURES",
+        "channel": channel,
+        "instId": instrument.to_bitget_symbol(),
+    }
+
+
+def _instrument_from_arg(arg: dict, known: set[InstrumentId]) -> InstrumentId | None:
+    inst_id = str(arg.get("instId") or "").upper()
+    inst_type = str(arg.get("instType") or "").upper()
+    if inst_type == "SPOT":
+        market_type = "spot"
+    elif inst_type == "USDT-FUTURES":
+        market_type = "perp"
+    else:
+        return None
+    return next(
+        (item for item in known if item.market_type == market_type and item.symbol.replace("/", "").upper() == inst_id),
+        None,
+    )
+
+
+def _positive(value: object) -> float | None:
+    try:
+        number = float(value)
+    except (TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None
+    return number if number > 0 else None
+
+
+def parse_bitget_message(
+    message: dict,
+    instruments: set[InstrumentId],
+    *,
+    received_timestamp_ms: int | None = None,
+) -> list[FastMarketEvent]:
+    """Parse one Bitget data message; control/invalid messages yield no events."""
+
+    arg = message.get("arg")
+    data = message.get("data")
+    if not isinstance(arg, dict) or not isinstance(data, list):
+        return []
+    instrument = _instrument_from_arg(arg, instruments)
+    if instrument is None:
+        return []
+    channel = str(arg.get("channel") or "")
+    received = received_timestamp_ms if received_timestamp_ms is not None else int(time.time() * 1000)
+    raw_message_ts = message.get("ts")
+    message_ts = received if raw_message_ts is None else _nonnegative_int(raw_message_ts)
+    if message_ts is None:
+        return []
+    events: list[FastMarketEvent] = []
+    rows = data
+    if channel == "trade":
+        try:
+            rows = sorted(data, key=lambda item: int(item.get("ts") or 0))
+        except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
+            return []
+    for index, row in enumerate(rows):
+        if not isinstance(row, (dict, list, tuple)):
+            continue
+        if isinstance(row, dict):
+            raw_ts = row.get("ts")
+            ts = message_ts if raw_ts is None else _nonnegative_int(raw_ts)
+            raw_sequence = row.get("seq")
+            if raw_sequence is None:
+                raw_sequence = row.get("seqId")
+            sequence = (
+                message_ts * 1000 + index
+                if raw_sequence is None
+                else _nonnegative_int(raw_sequence)
+            )
+        else:
+            ts = _nonnegative_int(row[0]) if row else received
+            # Candle rows repeat their bar-open timestamp throughout the minute;
+            # use the envelope update timestamp as the event sequence identity.
+            sequence = message_ts * 1000 + index
+        if ts is None or sequence is None:
+            continue
+        common = {
+            "instrument": instrument,
+            "exchange_timestamp_ms": ts,
+            "received_timestamp_ms": received,
+            "sequence": sequence,
+        }
+        if channel == "ticker" and isinstance(row, dict):
+            bid = _positive(row.get("bidPr") or row.get("bid1Price"))
+            ask = _positive(row.get("askPr") or row.get("ask1Price"))
+            if bid is not None and ask is not None and ask >= bid:
+                events.append(FastMarketEvent(event_type="quote", bid=bid, ask=ask, **common))
+        elif channel == "trade" and isinstance(row, dict):
+            price = _positive(row.get("price"))
+            size = _positive(row.get("size"))
+            side = str(row.get("side") or "").lower()
+            if price is not None and size is not None and side in {"buy", "sell"}:
+                events.append(FastMarketEvent(event_type="trade", price=price, size=size, side=side, **common))
+        elif channel == "books5" and isinstance(row, dict):
+            try:
+                bids = tuple((float(level[0]), float(level[1])) for level in row.get("bids", ()))
+                asks = tuple((float(level[0]), float(level[1])) for level in row.get("asks", ()))
+            except (TypeError, ValueError, IndexError):
+                continue
+            if bids and asks and all(price > 0 and size >= 0 for price, size in bids + asks):
+                events.append(FastMarketEvent(event_type="depth", bids=bids, asks=asks, **common))
+        elif channel == "candle1m" and isinstance(row, (list, tuple)) and len(row) >= 6:
+            try:
+                candle = tuple(float(value) for value in row[1:6])
+            except (TypeError, ValueError):
+                continue
+            if all(value > 0 for value in candle[:4]) and candle[4] >= 0:
+                events.append(FastMarketEvent(event_type="candle", candle=candle, **common))
+    return events
+
+
+class BitgetFastMarketStream:
+    """Credential-free Bitget public WebSocket stream."""
+
+    def __init__(self, endpoint: str = _BITGET_PUBLIC_WS):
+        self.endpoint = endpoint
+        self._session: aiohttp.ClientSession | None = None
+        self._ws: aiohttp.ClientWebSocketResponse | None = None
+        self._instruments: set[InstrumentId] = set()
+        self._confirmed: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
+        self._health = FastStreamHealth()
+        self._ping_task: asyncio.Task | None = None
+        self._pong_event: asyncio.Event | None = None
+        self._stream_generation_id: str | None = None
+        self._subscription_generations: dict[InstrumentId, str] = {}
+        self._channel_facts: dict[tuple[InstrumentId, str], FastMarketEvent] = {}
+
+    async def connect(self, instruments: set[InstrumentId] | None = None) -> None:
+        if self._ws is not None and not self._ws.closed:
+            return
+        self._session = aiohttp.ClientSession()
+        try:
+            self._ws = await self._session.ws_connect(self.endpoint, heartbeat=None)
+        except Exception:
+            await self._session.close()
+            self._session = None
+            self._health = FastStreamHealth(reason="fast_trigger_stream_connect_failed:bitget")
+            raise
+        self._confirmed.clear()
+        self._stream_generation_id = uuid4().hex
+        self._health = FastStreamHealth(connected=True)
+        self._pong_event = asyncio.Event()
+        self._ping_task = asyncio.create_task(self._ping_loop(), name="bitget-fast-stream-ping")
+
+    async def _ping_loop(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            while self._ws is not None and not self._ws.closed:
+                await asyncio.sleep(30)
+                if self._pong_event is None:
+                    return
+                self._pong_event.clear()
+                await self._ws.send_str("ping")
+                try:
+                    await asyncio.wait_for(self._pong_event.wait(), timeout=10)
+                except TimeoutError:
+                    self._health = self._health.model_copy(
+                        update={
+                            "connected": False,
+                            "subscriptions_confirmed": False,
+                            "reason": "fast_trigger_stream_pong_timeout:bitget",
+                        }
+                    )
+                    await self._ws.close()
+                    return
+        except asyncio.CancelledError:
+            raise
+        except Exception:
+            self._health = self._health.model_copy(
+                update={
+                    "connected": False,
+                    "subscriptions_confirmed": False,
+                    "reason": "fast_trigger_stream_disconnected:bitget",
+                }
+            )
+
+    async def set_instruments(self, instruments: set[InstrumentId]) -> None:
+        if self._ws is None or self._ws.closed:
+            raise RuntimeError("fast_trigger_stream_not_connected:bitget")
+        if any(item.exchange != "bitget" for item in instruments):
+            raise ValueError("fast_trigger_stream_venue_mismatch:bitget")
+        previous = self._instruments
+        removed = previous - instruments
+        added = instruments - previous
+        if removed:
+            await self._ws.send_json(
+                {
+                    "op": "unsubscribe",
+                    "args": [_bitget_arg(item, channel) for item in removed for channel in _CHANNELS],
+                }
+            )
+        self._instruments = set(instruments)
+        for instrument in removed:
+            self._subscription_generations.pop(instrument, None)
+            for channel in _CHANNEL_FRESHNESS_MS:
+                self._channel_facts.pop((instrument, channel), None)
+        for instrument in added:
+            self._subscription_generations[instrument] = uuid4().hex
+        if added:
+            await self._ws.send_json(
+                {
+                    "op": "subscribe",
+                    "args": [_bitget_arg(item, channel) for item in added for channel in _CHANNELS],
+                }
+            )
+        self._health = self._health.model_copy(update={"subscriptions_confirmed": False})
+
+    def _record_ack(self, payload: dict) -> None:
+        if payload.get("event") != "subscribe" or not isinstance(payload.get("arg"), dict):
+            return
+        arg = payload["arg"]
+        self._confirmed.add(
+            (
+                str(arg.get("instType") or ""),
+                str(arg.get("channel") or ""),
+                str(arg.get("instId") or ""),
+            )
+        )
+        expected = {
+            (value["instType"], value["channel"], value["instId"])
+            for item in self._instruments
+            for value in (_bitget_arg(item, channel) for channel in _CHANNELS)
+        }
+        self._health = self._health.model_copy(
+            update={"subscriptions_confirmed": bool(expected) and expected <= self._confirmed}
+        )
+
+    async def events(self) -> AsyncIterator[FastMarketEvent]:
+        if self._ws is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("fast_trigger_stream_not_connected:bitget")
+        async for message in self._ws:
+            received = int(time.time() * 1000)
+            if message.type == aiohttp.WSMsgType.TEXT:
+                if message.data == "pong":
+                    if self._pong_event is not None:
+                        self._pong_event.set()
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    payload = json.loads(message.data)
+                except (TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
+                    continue
+                self._record_ack(payload)
+                self._health = self._health.model_copy(update={"last_received_at_ms": received})
+                for event in parse_bitget_message(payload, self._instruments, received_timestamp_ms=received):
+                    event = event.model_copy(
+                        update={
+                            "stream_generation_id": self._stream_generation_id,
+                            "subscription_generation_id": self._subscription_generations.get(
+                                event.instrument
+                            ),
+                        }
+                    )
+                    self._channel_facts[(event.instrument, event.event_type)] = event
+                    yield event
+            elif message.type in {
+                aiohttp.WSMsgType.CLOSE,
+                aiohttp.WSMsgType.CLOSED,
+                aiohttp.WSMsgType.ERROR,
+            }:
+                break
+        self._health = self._health.model_copy(
+            update={
+                "connected": False,
+                "subscriptions_confirmed": False,
+                "reason": "fast_trigger_stream_disconnected:bitget",
+            }
+        )
+
+    def health(self) -> FastStreamHealth:
+        return self._health.model_copy()
+
+    def monitoring_state(
+        self,
+        instrument: InstrumentId,
+        required_channels: tuple[str, ...],
+    ) -> dict:
+        return _monitoring_projection(
+            instrument=instrument,
+            required_channels=required_channels,
+            connected=bool(self._ws is not None and not self._ws.closed),
+            stream_generation_id=self._stream_generation_id,
+            subscription_generation_id=self._subscription_generations.get(instrument),
+            channel_facts=self._channel_facts,
+            reason=self._health.reason,
+        )
+
+    async def close(self) -> None:
+        if self._ping_task is not None:
+            self._ping_task.cancel()
+            await asyncio.gather(self._ping_task, return_exceptions=True)
+            self._ping_task = None
+        self._pong_event = None
+        self._stream_generation_id = None
+        self._subscription_generations.clear()
+        self._channel_facts.clear()
+        if self._ws is not None:
+            await self._ws.close()
+            self._ws = None
+        if self._session is not None:
+            await self._session.close()
+            self._session = None
+        self._health = FastStreamHealth(reason="fast_trigger_stream_closed:bitget")
+
+
+def register_fast_market_stream() -> None:
+    from aletheia.universe.fast_stream import configure_fast_market_stream
+
+    configure_fast_market_stream("bitget_demo", BitgetFastMarketStream,
+        market_types=frozenset({"spot", "perp", "futures", "swap", "usdt_futures"}))

+"""bitget public instrument metadata decoding; no clients or persistence."""
+
+from aletheia.data.symbols import build_instrument_background, stock_token_to_ticker, to_canonical
+
+
+def decode_instrument_background(*, symbol: str, market_type: str, market_info: dict) -> dict:
+    canonical = to_canonical(symbol)
+    base, _, quote = canonical.partition("/")
+    raw = market_info.get("info") or {}
+    underlying_type = str(raw.get("underlyingType") or "").upper()
+    contract_type = str(raw.get("symbolType") or "").upper()
+    subtypes = []
+    raw_base = str(raw.get("baseCoin") or market_info.get("base") or base)
+    raw_quote = str(market_info.get("quote") or quote)
+    stock_ticker = stock_token_to_ticker(f"{raw_base}/{raw_quote}")
+    default_crypto = market_type in {"spot", "perp"}
+    if stock_ticker or underlying_type.endswith("EQUITY"):
+        asset_class = "equity"
+    elif underlying_type in {"COMMODITY", "INDEX"}:
+        asset_class = underlying_type.lower()
+    elif underlying_type:
+        asset_class = "crypto" if underlying_type == "COIN" else "unknown"
+    else:
+        asset_class = "crypto" if default_crypto else "unknown"
+    return build_instrument_background(
+        symbol=symbol, venue="bitget", market_type=market_type,
+        asset_class=asset_class, stock_ticker=stock_ticker,
+        classification={
+            "source": (
+                "exchange_metadata"
+                if underlying_type or stock_ticker
+                else "supported_market_default" if default_crypto else "unresolved"
+            ),
+            "underlying_type": underlying_type or None,
+            "contract_type": contract_type or None,
+            "underlying_subtypes": subtypes,
+        },
+    )

+"""Public funding inputs already carried by Bitget ticker and contract metadata."""
+
+
+async def read_funding(exchange, symbol, ticker):
+    market = (getattr(exchange, "markets", {}) or {}).get(symbol) or {}
+    hours = (market.get("info") or {}).get("fundInterval")
+    return (
+        {"fundingRate": ticker.get("funding_rate"), "markPrice": ticker.get("mark_price"),
+         "timestamp": ticker.get("source_timestamp_ms")},
+        f"{hours}h", "bitget.contracts.fundInterval",
+        getattr(exchange, "_candidate_markets_acquired_at", None),
+    )
+
+
+async def read_comparison_funding(exchange, markets, fetch):
+    """Bitget public funding batches must be homogeneous in settlement currency."""
+    result = {}
+    for settle in sorted({market["settle"] for market in markets.values()}):
+        group = [market["symbol"] for market in markets.values() if market["settle"] == settle]
+        result.update(await fetch(exchange.fetch_funding_rates, group,
+            params={"method": "publicMixGetV2MixMarketCurrentFundRate"}) or {})
+    return result

+

+        mode = cfg.exchange.paper_execution_mode or ""

+        return "bitget_profile", True, f"bitget_profile={profile!r} (bitget not active)"
+    if profile == "uta_v3":
+        return "bitget_profile", True, "bitget_profile=uta_v3 (Experimental — Demo qualification required before live use)"
+    return "bitget_profile", True, f"bitget_profile={profile!r} (classic_v2, active)"

index 000000000..5b2303cc5

+"""CCXT response metadata; concrete field proof is supplied by composition."""
+
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+import json
+import math
+from aletheia.data.freshness import MAX_FUTURE_SKEW
+
+from aletheia.data.derivatives_facts import (
+    finite, snapshot_metadata,
+)
+
+
+def provider_source_time(
+    raw: dict,
+    acquired_at: datetime,
+) -> tuple[str | None, str]:
+    """Normalize one CCXT source timestamp without inventing source-now."""
+    raw_timestamp = raw.get("timestamp")
+    raw_datetime = raw.get("datetime")
+    try:
+        if raw_timestamp is not None:
+            if isinstance(raw_timestamp, bool):
+                return None, "invalid"
+            timestamp = float(raw_timestamp)
+            if not math.isfinite(timestamp):
+                return None, "invalid"
+            parsed = datetime.fromtimestamp(timestamp / 1000, timezone.utc)
+        elif raw_datetime:
+            parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(str(raw_datetime).replace("Z", "+00:00"))
+            if parsed.tzinfo is None:
+                parsed = parsed.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)
+            parsed = parsed.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+        else:
+            return None, "missing"
+    except (OSError, OverflowError, TypeError, ValueError):
+        return None, "invalid"
+
+    acquired_at = acquired_at.astimezone(timezone.utc)
+    if parsed > acquired_at + MAX_FUTURE_SKEW:
+        return parsed.isoformat(), "future"
+    return parsed.isoformat(), "provided"
+
+
+def funding_interval_seconds(raw):
+    interval = raw.get('interval')
+    hours = finite(interval[:-1]) if isinstance(interval, str) and interval.endswith('h') else None
+    return finite(hours * 3600) if hours is not None and hours > 0 else None
+
+
+def instrument_from_market(symbol: str, market: dict) -> dict:
+    return dict(
+        canonical_symbol=symbol,
+        source_instrument_id=market.get("id"),
+        market_type="perp" if market.get("swap") else market.get("type"),
+        base_asset=market.get("base"),
+        quote_asset=market.get("quote"),
+        settle_asset=market.get("settle"),
+        linear=market.get("linear"),
+        contract_size=finite(market.get("contractSize")),
+    )
+
+
+def ccxt_metadata(symbol, venue, market, raw, *, family, ratios=None, acquired_at=None,
+                  oi_value_fields=(), funding_timestamp_field=None):
+    """Persist only semantics proved by the current CCXT response, never its fallback arithmetic."""
+    info = raw.get("info") or {}
+    unit = None
+    # CCXT 4.5.56 maps these explicitly USD-native fields to openInterestValue.
+    # Amount-only responses stay unknown here until a compatible mark/unit is proved.
+    if isinstance(info, dict):
+        value = finite(raw.get("openInterestValue"))
+        if value is not None and any(finite(info.get(key)) == value for key in oi_value_fields):
+            unit = "USD"
+    instrument = instrument_from_market(symbol, market)
+    if raw.get('symbol') is not None and raw['symbol'] != market.get('symbol'):
+        instrument['source_instrument_id'] = None
+    metadata = snapshot_metadata(
+        provider="ccxt",
+        venue=venue,
+        instrument=instrument,
+        interval_seconds=funding_interval_seconds(raw) if family == "funding" else None,
+        oi_unit=unit if family == "open_interest" else None,
+        ratios=ratios,
+    )
+    if funding_timestamp_field and family == 'funding' and isinstance(info, dict) and info.get(funding_timestamp_field) is not None:
+        acquired = datetime.fromisoformat(acquired_at) if acquired_at else datetime.now(timezone.utc)
+        source, status = provider_source_time({'timestamp': info[funding_timestamp_field]}, acquired)
+        data = json.loads(metadata)
+        data.update(source_observed_at=source, source_time_status=status)
+        metadata = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), allow_nan=False)
+    return metadata

+"""Credential-free CCXT public market metadata for the Exchange boundary."""
+
+from aletheia.data.symbols import to_canonical
+
+
+async def load_public_listing(venue: str, spot_only: bool) -> frozenset[str]:
+    """Normalize one pinned venue's listing; spot-only and all-market scopes differ."""
+    from aletheia.data.ccxt_provider import get_market_data_provider
+
+    provider = get_market_data_provider(
+        exchange=venue, native_ccxt=True, fallback_exchange=venue,
+    )
+    try:
+        exchange = provider._ensure_primary()
+        if spot_only:
+            exchange.options["defaultType"] = "spot"
+        markets = await exchange.load_markets()
+        if not isinstance(markets, dict) or not markets:
+            raise ValueError("listing_market_metadata_unavailable")
+        listed = frozenset(
+            to_canonical(str(symbol))
+            for symbol, market in markets.items()
+            if isinstance(market, dict)
+            and ((market.get("spot") is True and market.get("active") is not False)
+                 if spot_only else market.get("active") != False)  # noqa: E712
+        )
+        if not listed:
+            raise ValueError("listing_scope_empty")
+        return listed
+    finally:
+        await provider.close()
+
+
+async def load_public_market_capabilities(
+    exchange_name: str,
+    *,
+    sandbox: bool = False,
+) -> dict[str, frozenset[str]]:
+    """Load active USDT spot/swap symbols through the generic CCXT factory.
+
+    This is public market metadata only: no credentials or private account
+    endpoints are involved. The caller owns no client; this helper always closes
+    the loop-local provider before returning or re-raising.
+    """
+    from aletheia.net import close_ccxt, make_ccxt
+
+    exchange, session = make_ccxt(exchange_name, options={"defaultType": "swap"})
+    try:
+        if sandbox:
+            exchange.set_sandbox_mode(True)
+        await exchange.load_markets()
+        symbols: dict[str, set[str]] = {"swap": set(), "spot": set()}
+        for info in exchange.markets.values():
+            if not info.get("active", True):
+                continue
+            market_type = info.get("type")
+            if market_type not in symbols:
+                continue
+            if (info.get("quote") or "").upper() != "USDT":
+                continue
+            canonical = to_canonical(f"{info.get('base', '')}/USDT")
+            symbols[market_type].add(canonical)
+        return {key: frozenset(value) for key, value in symbols.items()}
+    finally:
+        if not await close_ccxt(exchange, session):
+            raise RuntimeError("ccxt_cleanup_failed")
